stages.name: ① 一句完整的話
stages.goal: 先把「誰＋做什麼／是什麼」寫成完整的一句，再分開寫三句。
criteria: 寫三個簡單的完整句子，每句只說一件事
每句有主詞和動詞，be 動詞或一般動詞用對
he、she、it 或一個人當主詞時，現在式動詞的變化正確
句首大寫，句尾有標點；整題至少 10 字

grammar.title: 完整句子：主詞＋be 動詞，或主詞＋一般動詞
points: 先寫主詞（誰），再寫動詞：I study. 是完整的一句；只有 I 或 My school 還沒說完。句首大寫，句尾加句點。
介紹身分用 be 動詞：I am、he／she／it is、you／we／they are；例如 I am a student.。
說平常做的事用一般動詞：I like；he／she／it 或一個人當主詞時加 s／es。study 變 studies，have 變 has。
一個可數的東西前面常要 a／an（a nurse、an apple）；說「誰的」可用 my／your／our，或在名字、單數名詞後加 ’s，例如 a patient’s name（病人的姓名）。

examples.en: I am a nursing student.
examples.zh: 我是護理系學生。

examples.en: My mother is a nurse.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是護理師。

examples.en: We are students.
examples.zh: 我們是學生。

examples.en: I study English.
examples.zh: 我讀英文。

examples.en: She likes music.
examples.zh: 她喜歡音樂。

mistakes.why: 介紹身分也需要動詞；I 後面補上 am。
She 是第三人稱單數，現在式的 like 要加 s。

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about yourself and your family. Use am, is, and are.
tasks.zh: 一次先寫一句，分三句介紹自己和家人：分別用 am、is、are。三句合計至少 10 字，不用把句子連起來。
tasks.sample: I am a student. My mother is a nurse. We are a family.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about studying and reading. Use study, reads, and like.

tasks.sample: I study English. My sister reads books. We like our school.

tasks.zh: 分三句寫一位家人的喜好或活動，用 likes、plays、watches 各寫一句。提醒：一個人當主詞，動詞要有 s 或 es。
tasks.sample: My sister likes music. She plays tennis. She watches nursing videos.

tasks.zh: 分三句介紹學校裡的人或事物，用 has、teaches、helps 各寫一句。has 是 have 搭配一個人或事物的寫法。
tasks.sample: My school has a library. Our teacher teaches nursing. My friend helps students.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about yourself and nursing.

stages.name: ② 把句子寫長
stages.goal: 保留簡單句，再加上樣子、地點、時間或做事的頻率。
criteria: 分開寫三句，每句仍有主詞和動詞
依題目加入形容詞、地點、時間或頻率
形容詞和 always、usually、often 放在正確的位置
不必連成長句；整題至少 15 字

grammar.title: 讓簡單句更清楚：形容詞、地點、時間、頻率
points: 形容詞可以放名詞前面：a small room；也可以放 be 動詞後面：The room is small.。
地點放在動作後面：study in the library、work at school，說清楚在哪裡。
時間常放句尾：at seven 是七點，every morning 是每天早上；先寫完整句子，再加時間。
always／usually／often 通常放一般動詞前面（I often read），但放 be 動詞後面（She is often busy）。

examples.en: My school has a small library.
examples.zh: 我的學校有一間小圖書館。

examples.en: The classroom is bright.
examples.zh: 教室很明亮。

examples.en: I study in the library.
examples.zh: 我在圖書館讀書。

examples.en: She reads every evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上閱讀。

examples.en: My roommate is usually quiet.
examples.zh: 我的室友通常很安靜。

mistakes.why: 先把 study English 寫完整，再把時間 every day 放句尾。

mistakes.bad: I usually studies in my room.
mistakes.good: I usually study in my room.
mistakes.why: usually 不改變主詞；主詞是 I，所以用 study，不加 s。

tasks.sample: I bring fruit to our classroom after school. My friend brings cups in a large paper bag. We share the food at our class party.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your student card. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 使用自己的學生證：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I have a student card in my school bag. The card shows my photo beside my student number. I use my card at the library entrance.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing classes. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 認識護理課堂：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：textbook＝課本。
tasks.sample: I always bring my textbook to nursing class. Our teacher usually explains the lesson in a bright classroom. We often read the examples together after her explanation.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice room. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 認識學校的練習教室：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our school has a practice room beside the nursing office. The room has a bed near the wide window. Our teacher uses a model during our nursing lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing instructor. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 介紹實習指導老師：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：instructor＝指導老師。
tasks.sample: Our instructor is a nurse at a teaching hospital. She teaches students in the school practice room. We ask questions after our nursing lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice partner. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 和同學練習護理英文：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：textbook＝課本；notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My partner reads the instructions in our nursing textbook. I take notes in a small blue notebook. Our teacher checks our work during the practice lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice equipment. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 認識教室裡的器材：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；stethoscope＝聽診器；thermometer＝體溫計。
tasks.sample: Our teacher always has a thermometer in a small box. I usually hold a stethoscope during our nursing class. My partner often uses a notebook beside the practice bed.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital visit. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 第一次參觀醫院：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：reception＝接待處；lobby＝大廳。
tasks.sample: The hospital has a lobby near its main entrance. A nurse greets our group beside the reception desk. I follow my teacher through the wide hallway.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital entrance. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院入口：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: The hospital has a sign above the main door. A volunteer answers questions at the information desk. Our teacher leads the group through the hospital entrance.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital map. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 看醫院的樓層圖：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：ward＝病房；clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: The map shows the clinic on the ground floor. I read the map beside the hospital elevator. Our teacher points to the ward on the hospital map.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital reception. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院櫃檯的工作：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：receptionist＝櫃檯接待人員；volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: The receptionist always answers calls at the front desk. A visitor usually asks a question near the main entrance. The volunteer often gives directions beside the information sign.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital classroom. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 在醫院裡上課：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Our group has a lesson in the hospital classroom. My teacher shows a picture on the large screen. I write the words in my practice notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nurse's name badge. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 認識護理師的名牌：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：uniform＝制服；badge＝名牌。
tasks.sample: The nurse wears a badge on her blue uniform. The badge shows her name in large black letters. I read her name during our hospital tour.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your ward notebook. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 整理實習筆記：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；placement＝實習。
tasks.sample: I have a notebook for my hospital placement. My teacher checks my notes in the staff classroom. I write English words after my practice lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital waiting room. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 描述醫院等候區：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: The waiting room is always busy in the morning. Visitors usually sit near the large window. A nurse often opens the door at the start of the clinic.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital team. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院裡的團隊：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher knows a nurse at the local hospital. The nurse helps students during our morning visit. We thank the team at the end of the visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient's room. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 描述練習情境的病房：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: The room has a window beside the hospital bed. A patient reads a book in a chair by the window. A nurse enters the room at nine in the morning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your visitor's questions. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 練習聽懂訪客問題：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: A visitor asks a question at the information desk. The volunteer checks a map beside the main door. Our teacher explains the words in our nursing classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient role play. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 課堂上扮演病人：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My classmate always plays a patient during our English lesson. I usually play a student nurse in the school practice room. Our teacher often listens to us beside the practice bed.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your greetings practice. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 練習簡單的英文問候：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：role play＝角色扮演。
tasks.sample: I greet my teacher at the classroom door. My partner says hello to our English tutor. We practice our greetings before the nursing role play.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your listening practice at school. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 聽簡單的護理對話：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Our teacher plays a recording in the school classroom. I listen to the nurse in the short recording. My partner writes the words in her English notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital sign practice. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 練習認識醫院標示：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I read a sign near the hospital door. The sign shows an arrow beside the English words. My teacher explains the meaning during our hospital visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school health office. Use always, usually, and often.
tasks.zh: 認識學校健康中心：用 always（總是）、usually（通常）、often（常常）各寫一句。頻率放一般動詞前、be 動詞後，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: The school nurse is always kind to me. The nurse usually answers questions during the lunch break. I often visit the office with my teacher on Monday.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice checklist. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 使用課堂練習清單：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：checklist＝檢查清單。
tasks.sample: Our teacher gives us a checklist before the nursing lesson. I read the items at my desk in class. My partner checks the list after our practice activity.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English learning goal. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 寫出自己的英文學習目標：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: I study English at school every morning. My family supports my plan for a nursing job in America. I practice English in my dormitory after class every day.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your American pen pal. Add details about place, time, or appearance.
tasks.zh: 和美國筆友互相介紹：在完整的三句上加細節。可以補地點、時間或樣子；一句先說一件事，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My pen pal is a student at a school in America. She writes letters to me every month. I read her letters at my desk after school.

stages.name: ③ 否定句和問句
stages.goal: 把熟悉的現在式句子改成「不……」和簡單的問題。
criteria: 寫出題目指定的三句，否定句和問句都算一句
一般動詞用 do／does，be 動詞用 am／is／are
does／doesn’t 後面的動詞回到原形
問句用問號，整題至少 15 字

grammar.title: 否定和問句：先分清楚 be 動詞與一般動詞
points: 一般動詞的否定用 don’t／doesn’t＋原形動詞：I don’t drink；she doesn’t drink，不再加 s。
be 動詞的否定直接加 not：am not、is not（isn’t）、are not（aren’t），不用 do。
問「是不是／有沒有」時，把 be 動詞移到主詞前；一般動詞則用 Do／Does＋主詞＋原形動詞。
問詳細資訊時，把 What（什麼）、Where（哪裡）、When（何時）放在問句前面：Where do you study?。

examples.en: I don't drink coffee at night.
examples.zh: 我晚上不喝咖啡。

examples.en: She doesn't live in the dormitory.
examples.zh: 她不住在宿舍。

examples.en: Our classroom isn't noisy.
examples.zh: 我們的教室不吵。

examples.en: Is she a nursing student?
examples.zh: 她是護理系學生嗎？

examples.en: What do you study at school?
examples.zh: 你在學校讀什麼？

mistakes.why: doesn’t 已經負責第三人稱，後面用原形 like。
這句的動詞是 is，直接把 is 放到主詞 she 前面。

tasks.prompt: Write three negative sentences about school life. Use don't, doesn't, and isn't.
tasks.zh: 分三句寫上學生活中「不做／不是」的事情，用 don’t、doesn’t、isn’t 各寫一句。
tasks.sample: I don't drink coffee at night. My roommate doesn't eat breakfast at school. Our classroom isn't noisy.

tasks.prompt: Write three questions about students at your school. Use Do you, Does she, and Are they.
tasks.zh: 寫三個問題，分別用 Do you、Does she、Are they 開頭。dormitory 是宿舍。
tasks.sample: Do you study English every day? Does she live in the school dormitory? Are they nursing students at our school?

tasks.prompt: Write three questions about a classmate's school day. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 問同學三個問題：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問什麼時候，各寫一句。
tasks.sample: What do you study at school? Where do you eat lunch every day? When does your first class start?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about people at school. Include one question with be and two negative sentences. Use Is she, isn't, and aren't.
tasks.zh: 寫三句：第一句用 Is she 問問題，第二句用 isn’t，第三句用 aren’t。be 動詞不用再加 do。
tasks.sample: Is she a nurse at our school? My classmate isn't late for class. We aren't in the library now.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about introducing your classmates. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 認識同班同學：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I am not a student at a nursing school. My classmate isn't a nurse at a small hospital. We don't study English in our classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about people in your family. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 介紹家中的成員：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Is my father a cook at a busy restaurant? Does my mother teach children at a local school? Do you study nursing in Taiwan?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about people in your dormitory. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 認識宿舍裡的人：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I don't share my room with my sister. Does my roommate study nursing at our school? Do we share a room on the second floor?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English teacher. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 介紹英文老師：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your English teacher teach? Where does she work every morning? When does your English class start?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your younger brother. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 弟弟的學習生活：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My brother doesn't read books in his small room. He doesn't study English after school every day. I don't help my brother at home every evening.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your older sister. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 姊姊的工作生活：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Is my sister a nurse at a large hospital? Does she like her work very much? Do we talk at home after dinner every day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your grandparents. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 和祖父母相處：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My grandfather doesn't like tea with his breakfast. Does my grandmother grow flowers in a small garden? Do you visit your grandparents every Sunday?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your study partner. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 和讀書夥伴互相幫忙：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your study partner read? Where do you study with your partner? When do you finish your homework?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school bag. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 整理上學用的書包：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't keep food in my school bag. My bag doesn't hold books in its large pocket. I don't carry my bag to school every morning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your pencil case. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 筆袋裡的文具：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you have three pens in your pencil case? Does my friend use a pencil in our English class? Do we need erasers for our drawing lesson?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school uniform. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 準備學校制服：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：uniform＝制服。
tasks.sample: I don't wear a uniform at school every day. Does my shirt have buttons down the front? Does my mother wash clothes at home every Sunday?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your name card. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己的名牌：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your name card show? Where do you keep your name card? When does your teacher check the cards?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing textbook. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 使用護理課本：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：textbook＝課本。
tasks.sample: I don't leave my nursing textbook at school. My friend doesn't read the book in the library. We don't study the pictures after class every Monday.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English notebook. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 寫英文筆記：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Do you write English words in a small notebook? Does my teacher check my spelling during our English class? Do you copy the examples after school every day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class timetable. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 看自己的課表：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: I don't have a timetable in my school bag. Does our school have six classes on Monday every week? Does my friend check the times before class every morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school library. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 認識學校圖書館：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What books do you borrow from the library? Where is your school library? When does the library open in the morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your classroom. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己的教室：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our classroom doesn't have windows on both sides. My teacher doesn't use a board at the front. We don't use our desks during every English lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class leader. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 班級幹部做的事：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: Does our class leader collect papers before the morning class? Does she help the teacher in our classroom? Do we follow the timetable on school days?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school office. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 到學校辦公室辦事：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員。
tasks.sample: The office doesn't have a printer beside the front desk. Do you bring your form to the office every term? Does the clerk check my name on the computer?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school cafeteria. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 在學生餐廳用餐：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：cafeteria＝學生餐廳。
tasks.sample: What do you eat for lunch? Where do your classmates eat their meals? When does the school cafeteria serve lunch?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your breakfast. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己的早餐：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't eat an egg for breakfast every morning. My sister doesn't drink milk at the kitchen table. We don't like our breakfast at home very much.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your lunch box. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 帶便當去上課：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you have a lunch box in your school bag? Does my lunch box hold rice in the large section? Does my father cook vegetables in our small kitchen?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dinner at home. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 和家人吃晚餐：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My mother doesn't make soup in the kitchen every evening. Do you set the table before dinner every day? Do we eat dinner at six every evening?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your fruit snack. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 下課吃水果：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What fruit does your friend like? Where do you buy your afternoon snack? When do you eat your fruit?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your water bottle. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 準備自己的水壺：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't have a bottle beside my school bag. My bottle doesn't hold water for my long school day. I don't wash my bottle at home every evening.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your grocery list. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 寫買菜清單：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you write a list at the kitchen table? Does my father buy eggs at the market every Saturday? Do we need rice for dinner this evening?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your trip to the bakery. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 到麵包店買早餐：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: The baker doesn't make bread early every morning. Do you choose a roll at the small bakery? Does my sister pay for breakfast at the front counter?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your food preferences. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己的食物喜好：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your brother like for dinner? Where does your family buy vegetables? When do you usually have your evening meal?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bus ride. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 搭公車去上學：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't take a bus to school every morning. The driver doesn't open the door at the school bus stop. My friend doesn't carry a bag on the bus every day.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your walk to class. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 從校門走到教室：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you walk to school at seven every morning? Does my friend meet me near the school gate? Do we enter the classroom before our first class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your train trip home. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 搭火車回家：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't buy a ticket at the train station. Does the train have seats beside large windows? Does my father meet me at the station every Friday?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bicycle. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 騎腳踏車上學：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What color is your bicycle? Where do you keep your bicycle at school? When do you ride it to class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your rainy school day. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 下雨天去上課：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't carry an umbrella in my school bag. My friend doesn't wear a coat on rainy school days. We don't walk to class from the main gate.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your shoes. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 準備上課穿的鞋子：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you have school shoes beside your bedroom door? Do my shoes have laces across the top? Do you wear your shoes to school every day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bedroom. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己的臥室：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My room doesn't have a bed beside the small window. Do you have a desk near your bedroom door? Does my brother share my room at our family home?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your desk. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 整理讀書的書桌：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What do you keep on your desk? Where is your desk in the room? When do you use your desk lamp?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bedroom shelf. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 整理房間的書架：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My shelf doesn't hold textbooks beside my writing desk. I don't arrange my books on the lower shelf. My sister doesn't keep her photos on the upper shelf.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your laundry. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 清洗自己的衣服：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: Do you wash your clothes at the dormitory on Saturday? Does my roommate hang her shirts on the drying rack? Do we fold our clothes in our room every week?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your clean room. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 整理自己的房間：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't clean my room on Sunday every week. Does my brother sweep the floor after breakfast every Sunday? Do we use a broom from the small closet?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dormitory kitchen. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 在宿舍廚房準備餐點：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: What do you cook in the shared kitchen? Where does your roommate keep the bowls? When do you wash the dishes?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dormitory notice board. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 看宿舍公布欄：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: The dormitory doesn't have a notice board beside the main door. I don't read the notices before breakfast every morning. Our manager doesn't post information on Monday every week.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your room key. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 保管自己的房間鑰匙：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: Do you have a key in your school bag? Does my key open the door to my dormitory room? Does my roommate keep her key in a small pocket?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your alarm clock. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 設定早上起床的鬧鐘：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't have a clock beside my small bed. Does my clock ring at six every morning? Do you get up before your first class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your evening routine. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 介紹晚上的生活：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: What do you read in the evening? Where does your roommate finish her homework? When do you usually go to bed?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your weekend phone call. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 週末打電話回家：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: I don't call my mother from my dormitory every Sunday. My mother doesn't ask questions about my school life. I don't tell my family stories about my nursing classes.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family photos. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 看家庭照片：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you have a photo beside your study desk? Does my photo show my family in our garden? Does my sister take pictures with her small camera?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family dog. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 照顧家裡的狗：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our dog doesn't sleep in the kitchen at night. Does our dog eat its food in the kitchen every morning? Do you walk our dog after school every day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your garden. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 整理家裡的小花園：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What flowers does your family grow? Where do you keep the garden tools? When does your father water the plants?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your housework. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 分擔家裡的工作：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't wash the dishes after dinner every evening. My brother doesn't take out the trash before school every morning. Our father doesn't clean the kitchen on Saturday every week.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family calendar. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 看家裡的行事曆：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Does our family have a calendar on the kitchen wall? Does my mother write the dates in a small notebook? Do you check our plans before school every morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your music practice. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 練習自己喜歡的音樂：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't play the piano at home every Sunday. Does my sister play the guitar in her room after school? Do we like music very much?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your badminton practice. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 和同學打羽毛球：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：racket＝球拍。
tasks.sample: What sports do you play at school? Where does your friend keep her racket? When do you practice badminton together?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your drawing hobby. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 課後畫圖：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't draw pictures at my desk after school. My friend doesn't use colored pencils in her art class. We don't show our pictures to our teacher every Friday.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your reading hobby. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 讀自己喜歡的書：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you read stories in bed every evening? Does my sister borrow novels from the local library? Do we like English books with simple pictures?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school club. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 參加學校社團：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our English club doesn't meet in the school library. Do you join the meeting every Tuesday after class? Does my friend lead the group in a small classroom?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class presentation. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 準備課堂報告：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your first slide show? Where do you practice your class presentation? When does your partner speak to the class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your vocabulary practice. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 練習英文單字：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't learn English words at my desk every evening. My teacher doesn't give examples during our morning class. I don't say the words with my partner after class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your pronunciation practice. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 練習英文發音：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you listen to English on your phone every evening? Does my teacher say each word slowly during our lesson? Do we repeat the sounds in our small classroom?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your spelling practice. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 練習英文拼字：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't spell my name in our English class. Does my partner write the letters on a small card? Does our teacher check our work at the end of class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dictionary. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 查閱自己的字典：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does this English word mean? Where do you keep your dictionary? When do you use it during your homework?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your online lesson. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 在宿舍上線上課：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't use a computer at my small desk. My teacher doesn't explain the lesson on the screen every evening. I don't type my answers in the online classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your writing practice. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 練習寫英文句子：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Do you write English sentences in your notebook every day? Does my friend read my work after our afternoon class? Do you check your spelling at the end of practice?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school test. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 準備學校的小考：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher doesn't give a test every Friday morning. Do you read each question at your desk in class? Does my classmate write her answers on the test paper?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your study break. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 讀書中間休息一下：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: What do you do during a study break? Where does your roommate take her break? When do you return to your desk?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school map. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 使用學校地圖：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our school doesn't have a map near the front gate. The map doesn't show the library beside the main building. I don't follow the signs on my way to class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your campus bookstore. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 到校內書局找文具：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員；receipt＝收據。
tasks.sample: Does the bookstore sell notebooks near the school library? Do you buy a pen at the front counter? Does the clerk give me a receipt after my purchase?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your lost notebook. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 請人幫忙找筆記本：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I don't need my notebook for my English lesson. Does my friend check my desk in our empty classroom? Does our teacher keep lost books in the school office?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school form. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 填寫學校的表格：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What information does the school form ask for? Where do you write your student number? When does the office need the form?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class photo. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 準備拍班級照片：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher doesn't hold a camera beside the classroom door. I don't stand beside my friend in front of our school. We don't smile for the photo after our last class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class party. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 和同學準備小聚會：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Do you bring fruit to our classroom after school? Does my friend bring cups in a large paper bag? Do we share the food at our class party?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your student card. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 使用自己的學生證：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't have a student card in my school bag. Does the card show my photo beside my student number? Do you use your card at the library entrance?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your first nursing class. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 認識護理課堂：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：textbook＝課本。
tasks.sample: What do you study in your first nursing class? Where does your teacher explain the lesson? When do you read your textbook?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice room. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 認識學校的練習教室：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our school doesn't have a practice room beside the nursing office. The room doesn't have a bed near the wide window. Our teacher doesn't use a model during our nursing lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing instructor. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 介紹實習指導老師：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：instructor＝指導老師。
tasks.sample: Is our instructor a nurse at a teaching hospital? Does she teach students in the school practice room? Do we ask questions after our nursing lesson?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice partner. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 和同學練習護理英文：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：textbook＝課本；notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My partner doesn't read the instructions in our nursing textbook. Do you take notes in a small blue notebook? Does our teacher check our work during the practice lesson?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice equipment. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 認識教室裡的器材：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：stethoscope＝聽診器。
tasks.sample: What does your teacher keep in the equipment box? Where is the stethoscope in the practice room? When does your nursing class start?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital visit. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 第一次參觀醫院：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：reception＝接待處；lobby＝大廳。
tasks.sample: The hospital doesn't have a lobby near its main entrance. A nurse doesn't greet our group beside the reception desk. I don't follow my teacher through the wide hallway.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital entrance. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院入口：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: Does the hospital have a sign above the main door? Does a volunteer answer questions at the information desk? Does our teacher lead the group through the hospital entrance?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital map. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 看醫院的樓層圖：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：ward＝病房；clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: The map doesn't show the clinic on the ground floor. Do you read the map beside the hospital elevator? Does our teacher point to the ward on the hospital map?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital reception. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院櫃檯的工作：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：receptionist＝櫃檯接待人員。
tasks.sample: What questions do hospital visitors ask? Where does the receptionist keep the map? When does the information desk open each morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital classroom. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 在醫院裡上課：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Our group doesn't have a lesson in the hospital classroom. My teacher doesn't show a picture on the large screen. I don't write the words in my practice notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nurse's name badge. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 認識護理師的名牌：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：uniform＝制服；badge＝名牌。
tasks.sample: Does the nurse wear a badge on her blue uniform? Does the badge show her name in large black letters? Do you read her name during our hospital tour?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your ward notebook. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 整理實習筆記：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；placement＝實習。
tasks.sample: I don't have a notebook for my hospital placement. Does my teacher check my notes in the staff classroom? Do you write English words after your practice lesson?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital waiting room. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 描述醫院等候區：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: What does the visitor read in the waiting room? Where are the chairs near the clinic? When does the clinic door open?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital team. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院裡的團隊：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher doesn't know a nurse at the local hospital. The nurse doesn't help students during our morning visit. We don't thank the team at the end of the visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient's room. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 描述練習情境的病房：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: Does the room have a window beside the hospital bed? Does a patient read a book in a chair by the window? Does a nurse enter the room at nine in the morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your visitor's questions. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 練習聽懂訪客問題：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: A visitor doesn't ask a question at the information desk. Does the volunteer check a map beside the main door? Does our teacher explain the words in our nursing classroom?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient role play. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 課堂上扮演病人：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What role does your classmate play? Where do you practice the patient conversation? When does the teacher listen to your group?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your greetings practice. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 練習簡單的英文問候：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：role play＝角色扮演。
tasks.sample: I don't greet my teacher at the classroom door. My partner doesn't say hello to our English tutor. We don't practice our greetings before the nursing role play.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your listening practice at school. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 聽簡單的護理對話：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Does our teacher play a recording in the school classroom? Do you listen to the nurse in the short recording? Does my partner write the words in her English notebook?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital sign practice. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 練習認識醫院標示：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: I don't read a sign near the hospital door. Does the sign show an arrow beside the English words? Does my teacher explain the meaning during our hospital visit?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school health office. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 認識學校健康中心：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What questions do you ask the school nurse? Where is the school health office? When does the office open each morning?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice checklist. Make all three sentences negative.
tasks.zh: 使用課堂練習清單：每句都寫成否定句；一般動詞用 don’t／doesn’t，be 動詞後面加 not。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：checklist＝檢查清單。
tasks.sample: Our teacher doesn't give us a checklist before the nursing lesson. I don't read the items at my desk in class. My partner doesn't check the list after our practice activity.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English learning goal. Ask three yes-or-no questions.
tasks.zh: 寫出自己的英文學習目標：三句都寫成問句；先看原來是 be 動詞還是一般動詞，再選 Is／Are 或 Do／Does。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: Do you study English at school every morning? Does your family support your plan for a nursing job in America? Do you practice English in your dormitory after class every day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your American pen pal. Include one negative sentence and two questions.
tasks.zh: 和美國筆友互相介紹：第一句寫否定句，另外兩句問問題；問句記得用問號。可以依真實生活改內容，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: My pen pal isn't a student at a school in America. Does she write letters to me every month? Do you read her letters at your desk after school?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing role model. Ask three questions. Use What, Where, and When.
tasks.zh: 介紹自己學習的榜樣：用 What 問什麼、Where 問哪裡、When 問何時，各寫一個問題。每句有主詞和動詞，問句記得用問號，三句合計至少 15 字。
tasks.sample: What does your aunt enjoy about nursing? Where does she work in Taiwan? When do you ask her about her work?

stages.name: ④ 寫昨天的事
stages.goal: 用三個簡單句，說清楚昨天或上週發生的事情。
criteria: 分開寫三句，內容是已經發生的事情
be 動詞用 was／were，一般動詞改成過去式
did／did not 後面用原形動詞
加入 yesterday 或 last week 等時間，整題至少 20 字

grammar.title: 過去式：was／were、動詞過去式、did
points: 已經過去的身分或狀態用 was／were：I／he／she／it was；you／we／they were。否定直接加 not。
規則動詞通常加 ed：watch → watched、clean → cleaned；study 要改成 studied。
常見不規則動詞要另外記：go → went、eat → ate、have → had；搭配 yesterday／last week 表示過去。
過去的一般動詞否定用 did not＋原形；問句用 Did＋主詞＋原形，不要同時再用過去式。

examples.en: I was at school yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在學校。

examples.en: We were in the library after lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐後在圖書館。

examples.en: She studied English last night.
examples.zh: 她昨晚讀英文。

examples.en: I went to school early yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天很早去學校。

examples.en: Did you finish your homework?
examples.zh: 你做完作業了嗎？

mistakes.why: did 已經表示過去，後面用原形 study。
We 的 be 動詞過去式要用 were。

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about yesterday at school. Use was, were, and was not.
tasks.zh: 分三句回想昨天在學校的情況，用 was、were、was not 各寫一句。
tasks.sample: I was in the school library yesterday afternoon. My classmates were in the classroom after lunch. Our teacher was not late yesterday.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your study day yesterday. Use studied, watched, and cleaned.
tasks.zh: 分三句寫昨天讀書或宿舍的事情，用 studied、watched、cleaned 各寫一句。before bedtime 是睡前。
tasks.sample: I studied English in my dormitory yesterday evening. My roommate watched a nursing video after dinner. We cleaned our small room before bedtime.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about yesterday. Use went, ate, and had.
tasks.zh: 分三句寫昨天，用 went（go 的過去式）、ate（eat 的過去式）、had（have 的過去式）各寫一句。cafeteria 是學生餐廳。
tasks.sample: I went to school early yesterday morning. My friend ate breakfast in the school cafeteria. We had an English class after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about yesterday at school. Include two negative sentences and one question. Use did not study, did not drink, and Did you.
tasks.zh: 寫三句：前兩句寫昨天沒做的事，最後一句問同學昨天的事。分別用 did not study、did not drink、Did you。
tasks.sample: I did not study in the library yesterday evening. My friend did not drink coffee after dinner. Did you finish your homework before bedtime?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about introducing your classmates yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識同班同學的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：meet → met（遇見）；be → was／were（是、在）。
tasks.sample: I met my new classmate at school yesterday morning. She was in my English class after lunch. We talked about our nursing lessons in the classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about people in your family yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹家中的成員的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：put → put（放）。
tasks.sample: My father cooked lunch for our family last Sunday. My mother washed the vegetables in our kitchen. I put the clean bowls on the table.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about people in your dormitory yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識宿舍裡的人的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I moved into the school dormitory last week. My roommate carried my books up to our room. We were tired after the long afternoon in our room.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English teacher yesterday or last week. Include one statement, one negative sentence, and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹英文老師的經驗：寫一個過去式敘述句、一個否定句和一個問句。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our English teacher showed us a picture yesterday. We did not understand one word in the lesson. Did you ask the teacher about that word after class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your younger brother yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想弟弟的學習生活的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: My brother studied English at home yesterday evening. I helped him with the spelling of three words. He finished his homework before dinner with our family.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your older sister yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想姊姊的工作生活的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；leave → left（離開、留下）。
tasks.sample: My sister left for the hospital early yesterday. She was home after her long shift in the afternoon. Did you talk to her about her day?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your grandparents yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想和祖父母相處的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：make → made（做）。
tasks.sample: I visited my grandparents with my family last Sunday. My grandmother made some tea in the small kitchen. We talked about my school life after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your study partner yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想和讀書夥伴互相幫忙的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；bring → brought（帶來）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My partner was in the school library yesterday afternoon. I brought my English notebook to our table. We did not finish all the practice questions before dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school bag yesterday or last week. Include one statement, one negative sentence, and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想整理上學用的書包的經驗：寫一個過去式敘述句、一個否定句和一個問句。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：put → put（放）。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: I packed my school bag after dinner yesterday. I did not put my lunch box inside it. Did you check your timetable before bed last night?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your pencil case yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想筆袋裡的文具的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；lend → lent（借給）。
tasks.sample: I opened my pencil case in class yesterday morning. My blue pen was under the small eraser. I lent my pencil to a classmate during our lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school uniform yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想準備學校制服的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；hang → hung（掛起）。小字典：uniform＝制服。
tasks.sample: I washed my school uniform at home last Saturday. My mother hung it near the window in the afternoon. It was dry before dinner with my family that evening.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your name card yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己的名牌的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：make → made（做）；put → put（放）。小字典：uniform＝制服。
tasks.sample: I made a new name card at school yesterday. My teacher checked the English spelling of my name. I put the card on my uniform before class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing textbook yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想使用護理課本的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：textbook＝課本。
tasks.sample: I read two pages of my nursing textbook yesterday. The pictures were clear on the first page. Did you look up the new words after class?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English notebook yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想寫英文筆記的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I copied three English examples into my notebook yesterday. My teacher checked the verbs during our afternoon lesson. I did not finish the last example before the bell.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class timetable yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想看自己的課表的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: I checked our class timetable before school last Monday. Our first lesson was in a different room that morning. Did you find the new classroom before eight?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school library yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識學校圖書館的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：librarian＝圖書館員。
tasks.sample: I borrowed an English book from the library yesterday. The librarian checked my student card at the counter. I read the first story after dinner in my room.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your classroom yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己的教室的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）。
tasks.sample: I arrived at our classroom early yesterday morning. My friend opened the windows before the first class. We were ready for our English lesson at eight.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class leader yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想班級幹部做的事的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our class leader collected the forms after class yesterday. I counted the papers on the teacher's desk. One student did not bring her form that morning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school office yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想到學校辦公室辦事的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：give → gave（給）。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員。
tasks.sample: I visited the school office with my friend yesterday. The clerk checked my student number on the computer. She gave me a new form after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school cafeteria yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想在學生餐廳用餐的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；eat → ate（吃）；buy → bought（買）。小字典：cafeteria＝學生餐廳。
tasks.sample: I ate lunch in the school cafeteria yesterday. My classmate bought a bowl of soup at the counter. We were back in our classroom before the afternoon lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your breakfast yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己的早餐的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：leave → left（離開、留下）；put → put（放）。
tasks.sample: I cooked an egg for breakfast yesterday morning. My sister put two cups on the kitchen table. We left home for school after our quiet breakfast.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your lunch box yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想帶便當去上課的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：make → made（做）；put → put（放）。
tasks.sample: My father made rice for my lunch yesterday morning. I put vegetables in my lunch box at home. Did you bring your own lunch to school yesterday?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dinner at home yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想和家人吃晚餐的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：eat → ate（吃）。
tasks.sample: Our family ate dinner together at home last night. I set the table before our family dinner. My brother washed the bowls after the meal.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your fruit snack yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想下課吃水果的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：eat → ate（吃）；buy → bought（買）；choose → chose（選擇）。
tasks.sample: I bought an apple near school yesterday afternoon. My friend chose a banana from the same shop. We ate our fruit outside the classroom before the next lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your water bottle yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想準備自己的水壺的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：leave → left（離開、留下）；find → found（找到）。
tasks.sample: I left my water bottle on the classroom desk yesterday. My classmate found it after our last lesson. I thanked her at the school gate in the afternoon.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your grocery list yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想寫買菜清單的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：buy → bought（買）；write → wrote（寫）。
tasks.sample: I wrote a grocery list with my father last Saturday. We bought eggs at the market near our home. We did not buy rice on that shopping trip.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your trip to the bakery yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想到麵包店買早餐的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：eat → ate（吃）；choose → chose（選擇）；go → went（去）。
tasks.sample: I went to the bakery before school yesterday morning. My sister chose a plain roll at the counter. We ate our breakfast at home before the bus ride.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your food preferences yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己的食物喜好的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our family tried a small noodle shop last Sunday. My brother ordered rice with vegetables for his lunch. Did you enjoy your meal at that shop?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bus ride yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想搭公車去上學的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；take → took（搭乘、拿、拍攝）。
tasks.sample: I missed the first bus to school yesterday morning. My friend was at the bus stop near my home. We took the next bus ten minutes later.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your walk to class yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想從校門走到教室的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：meet → met（遇見）。
tasks.sample: I walked to school with my classmate yesterday morning. We met near the main gate at seven thirty. Did you reach your classroom before the first bell?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your train trip home yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想搭火車回家的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：meet → met（遇見）；be → was／were（是、在）；buy → bought（買）。
tasks.sample: I bought a train ticket at the station last Friday. The train was full during the first part of the trip. My father met me at the station near home.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bicycle yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想騎腳踏車上學的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：ride → rode（騎）；wear → wore（穿戴）。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；helmet＝安全帽。
tasks.sample: I rode my bicycle to school yesterday morning. I wore my helmet during the ride from my dormitory. Did you leave your bicycle near the school gate?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your rainy school day yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想下雨天去上課的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）。
tasks.sample: It rained during our walk to school yesterday morning. My friend shared her umbrella near the main gate. Our shoes were wet after the walk to class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your shoes yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想準備上課穿的鞋子的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：wear → wore（穿戴）。
tasks.sample: I cleaned my school shoes at home last Saturday. My brother helped me with a clean cloth. I wore my clean shoes during our afternoon walk.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bedroom yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己的臥室的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: My brother moved his books into our bedroom yesterday. I cleared a shelf beside the small window. We arranged our desks after lunch with our parents.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your desk yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想整理讀書的書桌的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I cleared my study desk after class yesterday afternoon. My lamp was behind a pile of English books. I moved it beside my notebook before my evening practice.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your bedroom shelf yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想整理房間的書架的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：put → put（放）；find → found（找到）。小字典：textbook＝課本。
tasks.sample: I arranged my books on the shelf last Sunday. My sister put our family photos on the top shelf. We found an old storybook behind my nursing textbook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your laundry yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想清洗自己的衣服的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I washed my clothes in the dormitory last Saturday. My roommate carried the basket downstairs. We folded our clean clothes in our room after dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your clean room yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想整理自己的房間的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：sweep → swept（掃）。
tasks.sample: I cleaned my room with my brother last Sunday. He swept the floor near the small bedroom window. I did not finish the shelves before our lunch break.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dormitory kitchen yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想在宿舍廚房準備餐點的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：bring → brought（帶來）。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I cooked noodles in the shared kitchen yesterday evening. My roommate brought two bowls from our room. We washed the dishes after our meal at the table.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dormitory notice board yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想看宿舍公布欄的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I read the dormitory notice after breakfast yesterday. Our manager posted the new meeting time near the door. Did you write the date in your notebook?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your room key yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想保管自己的房間鑰匙的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：find → found（找到）；lose → lost（遺失）。小字典：roommate＝室友；notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I lost my room key after class yesterday afternoon. My roommate checked the pocket of my school bag. She found the key beside my small English notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your alarm clock yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想設定早上起床的鬧鐘的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：eat → ate（吃）；ring → rang（響）；get → got（得到；get up 起床）；get out → got out（離開）。小字典：cafeteria＝學生餐廳。
tasks.sample: My alarm rang at six yesterday morning. I got out of bed after the first ring. We ate breakfast at the cafeteria before our first class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your evening routine yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹晚上的生活的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：be → was／were（是、在）；read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I finished my homework in the dormitory last night. My roommate read a book beside the open window. We were tired after our long day at school.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your weekend phone call yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想週末打電話回家的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：tell → told（告訴）。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: I called my family from the dormitory last Sunday. My mother asked about my first nursing lesson. I told her a short story about my new classmate.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family photos yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想看家庭照片的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I showed my family photos to my friend yesterday. She recognized my sister in the picture near our front door. We talked about our families after the English lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family dog yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想照顧家裡的狗的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：bring → brought（帶來）；give → gave（給）。
tasks.sample: I walked our dog near home last Sunday morning. My brother brought its bowl into the kitchen. We gave the dog fresh water after the walk.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your garden yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想整理家裡的小花園的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I helped my father in our garden last Saturday. He planted a small tree beside the garden wall. I watered the flowers near our kitchen window.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your housework yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想分擔家裡的工作的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：take → took（搭乘、拿、拍攝）。
tasks.sample: I washed the dishes after dinner last night. My brother took out the trash before his evening study time. Our father cleaned the kitchen floor after the meal.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family calendar yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想看家裡的行事曆的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）。
tasks.sample: I checked our family calendar before school yesterday morning. My mother wrote the date of our next family meal. I added my English test date after breakfast.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your music practice yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想練習自己喜歡的音樂的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I practiced the piano in my room last Sunday. My sister played a song on her guitar after lunch. Did you listen to our music in the afternoon?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your badminton practice yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想和同學打羽毛球的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I played badminton with my friend after class yesterday. Our teacher watched the game beside the school court. We did not play another game before dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your drawing hobby yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想課後畫圖的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：draw → drew（畫）。
tasks.sample: I drew a picture of our school yesterday afternoon. My friend colored the trees with her green pencil. We showed our pictures to the teacher after class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your reading hobby yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想讀自己喜歡的書的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。
tasks.sample: I read a short English story in bed last night. My sister borrowed a new novel from the library yesterday. Did you finish your book before bedtime?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school club yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想參加學校社團的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I joined the English club meeting last Tuesday. Our leader introduced a simple question game to the group. We practiced the game in a small classroom after school.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class presentation yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想準備課堂報告的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：choose → chose（選擇）。
tasks.sample: I prepared the first slide for our presentation yesterday. My partner chose a picture of our school library. We practiced our short talk in the classroom after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your vocabulary practice yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習英文單字的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：give → gave（給）；write → wrote（寫）。
tasks.sample: I learned five English words at my desk yesterday evening. My teacher gave us examples in the morning lesson. I wrote one sentence for each word after dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your pronunciation practice yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想練習英文發音的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I listened to an English recording at home yesterday. I repeated the sentence slowly after the speaker. Did you practice the same sentence in your room last night?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your spelling practice yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習英文拼字的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）。
tasks.sample: I spelled my name for our new teacher yesterday. My partner wrote the letters on a small card. The teacher checked both our names before the lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your dictionary yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想查閱自己的字典的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）；find → found（找到）。
tasks.sample: I used my dictionary during our English homework yesterday. I found the new word near the end of the book. Did you read the example beside the word?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your online lesson yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想在宿舍上線上課的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: I joined an online English lesson last night. My teacher explained the picture on the screen. I typed three short answers into the chat box.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your writing practice yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習寫英文句子的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I wrote three English sentences in my notebook yesterday. My friend checked the first verb after class. I changed one word in the last sentence before dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school test yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想準備學校的小考的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）；give → gave（給）。
tasks.sample: Our teacher gave us a short English test yesterday. I read every question on the first page of the test. Did you check your spelling at the end of the test?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your study break yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想讀書中間休息一下的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：take → took（搭乘、拿、拍攝）。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I took a short break after my homework yesterday. My roommate opened the window in our small room. We walked outside for ten minutes before our evening lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school map yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想使用學校地圖的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：find → found（找到）。
tasks.sample: I checked the school map near the gate yesterday. My friend found our new classroom on the second floor. We asked a teacher about the stairs near the library.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your campus bookstore yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想到校內書局找文具的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：give → gave（給）；buy → bought（買）。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員；notebook＝筆記本；receipt＝收據。
tasks.sample: I bought a notebook at the campus bookstore yesterday. The clerk gave me a receipt at the front counter. My friend did not buy a pen on that visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your lost notebook yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想請人幫忙找筆記本的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：find → found（找到）；lose → lost（遺失）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I lost my English notebook after class yesterday. My friend looked under my desk in the classroom. Our teacher found it on a table in the library.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school form yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想填寫學校的表格的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：fill in → filled in（填寫）。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員。
tasks.sample: I filled in a school form yesterday morning. The clerk checked my name at the top of the page. Did you write your student number in the correct box?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class photo yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想準備拍班級照片的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：take → took（搭乘、拿、拍攝）；stand → stood（站）。
tasks.sample: Our class took a group photo at school yesterday. I stood beside my friend near the main gate. Our teacher showed us the picture after our last class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your class party yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想和同學準備小聚會的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：bring → brought（帶來）。
tasks.sample: I brought some fruit to our class party yesterday. My friend carried paper cups in a large bag. We shared the food in our classroom after school.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your student card yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想使用自己的學生證的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：librarian＝圖書館員。
tasks.sample: I used my student card at the library yesterday. The librarian checked my name beside the small photo. I borrowed two books for my English practice that afternoon.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your first nursing class yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識護理課堂的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。
tasks.sample: I attended my first nursing class yesterday morning. Our teacher explained the pictures in the first chapter. We read a short page together after the introduction.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice room yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識學校的練習教室的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our class visited the practice room at school yesterday. The teacher showed us a model beside the practice bed. I asked a question about the next lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing instructor yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
