tasks.zh: 回想介紹實習指導老師的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）；tell → told（告訴）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；instructor＝指導老師。
tasks.sample: Our instructor introduced herself in the classroom yesterday. She told us about our first hospital visit. I wrote the meeting time in my notebook after class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice partner yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想和同學練習護理英文的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I practiced a short dialogue with my classmate yesterday. She read the instructions in our English notebook. Our teacher checked our answers at the end of the lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice equipment yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識教室裡的器材的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；thermometer＝體溫計。
tasks.sample: Our teacher showed us a thermometer in class yesterday. I wrote its English name in my small notebook. My partner asked a question about the spelling after class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital visit yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想第一次參觀醫院的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：reception＝接待處。
tasks.sample: I visited a hospital with my nursing class yesterday. A nurse greeted our group near the reception desk. We followed our teacher through the main hallway.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital entrance yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識醫院入口的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：meet → met（遇見）。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: Our class met outside the hospital entrance yesterday morning. The volunteer showed us the sign above the main door. I waited with my teacher near the main door.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital map yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one question about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想看醫院的樓層圖的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再問一個關於過去的問題。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: I read the hospital map during our visit yesterday. My teacher pointed to the clinic on the ground floor. Did you find our meeting room on the map?

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital reception yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識醫院櫃檯的工作的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：receptionist＝櫃檯接待人員。
tasks.sample: A visitor asked for directions at the hospital yesterday. The receptionist showed him a map near the front desk. Our teacher explained the English words after the conversation.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital classroom yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想在醫院裡上課的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：give → gave（給）；write → wrote（寫）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: Our teacher gave us a lesson at the hospital yesterday. I wrote three new words in my notebook. We discussed the picture on the screen after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nurse's name badge yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識護理師的名牌的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：uniform＝制服；badge＝名牌。
tasks.sample: A nurse introduced herself during our hospital tour yesterday. I read her name on the badge on her uniform. We thanked her at the end of our visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your ward notebook yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想整理實習筆記的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本；placement＝實習。
tasks.sample: I reviewed my placement notes after class yesterday evening. My teacher checked three English words in the afternoon. I copied the correct spelling into my notebook before dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital waiting room yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想描述醫院等候區的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。小字典：clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: Our class waited near the clinic during yesterday's visit. A visitor read a book beside the large window. Our teacher called us back to the hallway after ten minutes.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital team yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識醫院裡的團隊的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher introduced a nurse to our group yesterday. The nurse answered two questions about student life. We thanked her at the end of our hospital visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient's room yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想描述練習情境的病房的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：draw → drew（畫）。
tasks.sample: I described a practice patient room in class yesterday. My partner drew a bed beside a large window. Our teacher asked us about the chair near the door.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your visitor's questions yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習聽懂訪客問題的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: I listened to a visitor's question during yesterday's hospital tour. The volunteer answered near the information desk. I asked my teacher about one new English word later.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your patient role play yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想課堂上扮演病人的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：give → gave（給）。
tasks.sample: My classmate played a patient in our lesson yesterday. I practiced a simple greeting beside the practice bed. Our teacher gave us feedback after the short dialogue.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your greetings practice yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習簡單的英文問候的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。小字典：role play＝角色扮演。
tasks.sample: I greeted my English teacher at the classroom door yesterday. My partner practiced a short introduction with me. We repeated the greeting before the start of our role play.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your listening practice at school yesterday or last week. Include two statements and one negative sentence about the past.
tasks.zh: 回想聽簡單的護理對話的經驗：寫兩個過去式敘述句，再寫一件沒有發生的事。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：hear → heard（聽見）。
tasks.sample: Our teacher played a nursing dialogue in class yesterday. I heard the greeting in the first part. I did not catch the room number on the first try.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your hospital sign practice yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想練習認識醫院標示的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）。
tasks.sample: I read an English sign during our hospital visit yesterday. The arrow pointed toward the main entrance. My teacher explained the new word after our tour.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school health office yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想認識學校健康中心的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。
tasks.sample: Our class visited the school health office yesterday morning. The nurse welcomed us near the office door. We asked about the English name of the room.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your practice checklist yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想使用課堂練習清單的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）；give → gave（給）。小字典：checklist＝檢查清單。
tasks.sample: Our teacher gave us a checklist before yesterday's practice. I read the items at my classroom desk. My partner checked our work at the end of the activity.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English learning goal yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想寫出自己的英文學習目標的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：read → read（讀；過去式同拼法，唸作 red）；write → wrote（寫）。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I wrote my English learning goal in my notebook yesterday. My family read my plan after dinner at home. We talked about my nursing studies during the evening.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your American pen pal yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想和美國筆友互相介紹的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：write → wrote（寫）。
tasks.sample: I received a letter from my American pen pal yesterday. She described her school in a short paragraph. I wrote three sentences about my own school after dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your nursing role model yesterday or last week. Describe three things that happened during one past day or visit.
tasks.zh: 回想介紹自己學習的榜樣的經驗：用三個簡單句回想某次活動：誰做了什麼、當時在哪裡或感覺如何。三句合計至少 20 字。這題可用的過去式：tell → told（告訴）。
tasks.sample: I called my aunt after my nursing class yesterday. She told me about her first year at school. I asked her about English practice during our evening call.

stages.name: ⑤ 連成一句
criteria: 文法正確（主詞動詞、時態）
用到題目指定的連接詞
意思清楚完整

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 用三句寫你的家人，要用到 and、but、because。
tasks.sample: My father is a bus driver, and my mother is a nurse. My brother likes sports, but I like reading. I love my grandmother because she always cooks for us.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school day. Use so, but, and when.
tasks.zh: 用三句寫你在學校的一天，要用到 so、but、when。
tasks.sample: My first class starts at eight, so I get up at six. Anatomy is interesting, but it is difficult. When classes finish, I study in the library.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a time you were sick. Use because, so, and after.
tasks.zh: 用三句寫你生病的一次經驗，要用到 because、so、after。
tasks.sample: I stayed home last week because I had a fever. I felt very tired, so I slept all day. After I took some medicine, I felt better.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences to give health advice. Use should, if, and because.
tasks.zh: 用三句給健康建議，要用到 should、if、because。
tasks.sample: On hot days, you should drink more water because you lose water when you sweat. If you feel dizzy, you should sit down. You should sleep early because sleep helps you learn.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about introducing a new classmate. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 介紹新同學：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My classmate is a nursing student, and I am a nursing student too. She likes science, but her brother likes art. We have the same English class, so we study together.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your family's evening. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 家人晚上的活動：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My father cooks dinner, and I wash the dishes. My sister reads a book, but my brother watches television. I sit with my family because I enjoy our evening talks.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your first week in the dormitory. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 剛住進宿舍的一週：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I carry my bag upstairs, and my roommate opens the door. Our room is small, but it has two large windows. I like our room because it is near my classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your English class. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 自己的英文課：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher writes a sentence, and we read it together. I know the words, but I need help with the spelling. I practice every day because English is important for my goal.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about helping your brother study. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 幫弟弟讀書：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My brother reads the question, and I listen to his answer. He likes stories, but he needs help with spelling. The question is new to him, so I show him an example.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your sister's workday. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 姊姊的一個工作日：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：uniform＝制服。
tasks.sample: My sister wears her uniform, and she takes a bus to work. She works at a hospital, but I still study at school. She goes to bed early because her shift starts in the morning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a visit to your grandparents. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 探望祖父母：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I visit my grandparents, and my brother comes with me. Their home is far away, but we enjoy the bus ride. We bring some fruit because our grandmother likes apples.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about studying with a partner. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 和夥伴一起讀書：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My partner reads the words, and I write them in my notebook. We enjoy our class, but some questions are difficult. We ask our teacher for help because we do not understand the example.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about packing your school bag. Use after, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 準備上學的書包：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: After I pack my books, I put my lunch box in my bag. My bag is old, but it still holds all my things. I need the right books for class, so I check my timetable.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about sharing school supplies. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 和同學分享文具：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I have a blue pen, and my friend has a black pen. She has a notebook, but she does not have an eraser. I lend her my eraser because she needs it for our drawing lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your school uniform. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 學校制服的日常：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：uniform＝制服。
tasks.sample: I put on my uniform, and I check my name card. My shirt is clean, but my shoes need some work. I wash my uniform on Saturday because I wear it during the week.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your first name card. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 第一次使用名牌：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write my name, and my teacher checks the spelling. The letters are small, but the name is clear. I wear my name card because the new teacher uses our names in class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using a nursing textbook. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 讀護理課本：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I read the page, and my partner looks at the picture. The picture is clear, but some English words are new. The lesson includes several new words, so I check the meaning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about keeping English notes. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 整理英文筆記：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After I write a word, I add a simple example. My notes are short, but each word has an example. I use a new page because the old page is full.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about checking the timetable. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 查看上課時間：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：timetable＝課表。
tasks.sample: My first class starts at eight, and my next class starts at ten. I like English, but nursing is my main subject. I check the timetable because the rooms are different for each class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about borrowing library books. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 借學校圖書館的書：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：librarian＝圖書館員。
tasks.sample: I choose a book, and the librarian checks my student card. The book is long, but the pictures are interesting. I borrow it because it has simple English stories for students.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about finding a seat in class. Use when, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 在教室找到座位：用 when 說當時發生的事、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: When I enter the classroom, my friend waves to me. The front row is full, but a seat near the window is empty. I see the board from that desk, so I sit there.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about helping the class leader. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 協助班級幹部：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After our class leader collects the forms, I count the papers. Most students finish quickly, but one student needs more time. We wait for him because all our forms go to the office together.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about visiting the school office. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 到學校辦公室：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：clerk＝辦事人員／店員。
tasks.sample: After I bring my form, the clerk checks my student number. The office is busy, but the clerk still answers my question. I visit the office because I need a new student card.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about lunch in the cafeteria. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在學生餐廳吃午餐：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：cafeteria＝學生餐廳。
tasks.sample: I buy some rice, and my friend buys a bowl of soup. The cafeteria is noisy, but the food is good. We eat there because it is close to our next classroom.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about making breakfast at home. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 在家準備早餐：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I cook an egg, and my sister puts bread on the table. I drink milk, but my father drinks tea. Our school day starts at eight, so we eat breakfast early.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about packing a lunch box. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 準備自己的便當：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My father cooks rice, and I put vegetables in my lunch box. My box is small, but it holds enough food for lunch. I bring my own lunch because I like my father's cooking.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about sharing dinner at home. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 和家人共享晚餐：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My mother serves the soup, and my brother brings the bowls. Our day is busy, but we still eat dinner together. I enjoy this time because everyone tells a story about the day.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about choosing an afternoon snack. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 選擇下午的點心：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I buy an apple, and my friend chooses a banana. The shop has cake, but I prefer fruit today. We have our snack now because our next class starts in an hour.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about remembering your water bottle. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 記得帶自己的水壺：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I fill my bottle, and I put it beside my bag. My bottle is large, but it fits in the side pocket. I do not want water on my books, so I check the cap.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about shopping with a list. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 照清單買食物：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write a shopping list, and my father carries the bag. We need eggs, but we already have enough rice. We check the list at the store because every item is on it.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about breakfast at the bakery. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在麵包店買早餐：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: The baker opens the shop, and I join the short line. I like sweet bread, but my sister prefers a plain roll. We come early because our first class starts at eight.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about different food preferences. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 家人喜歡不同食物：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I like noodles, and my brother likes rice. Our mother enjoys spicy food, but our father prefers mild food. We choose this restaurant because it has different dishes for everyone.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about catching the school bus. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 搭上去學校的公車：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I leave home at seven, and I walk to the bus stop. The bus is crowded, but I find a place near the door. It stops beside my school, so I take this bus.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about walking to class together. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 一起走到教室：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After my friend meets me at the gate, we walk to class together. The path is long, but the morning air is cool. We leave home early because we enjoy a quiet walk before class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about taking the train home. Use when, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 搭火車回家：用 when 說當時發生的事、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: When I buy a train ticket, I check the platform number. The train is busy, but a seat beside the window is empty. I call my father because he meets me at the station.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about riding a bicycle to school. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 騎腳踏車去學校：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：helmet＝安全帽。
tasks.sample: I put on my helmet, and I check my bicycle before the ride. The route is short, but the morning traffic is heavy. I leave early because a careful ride to school takes time.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a rainy morning. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 下雨的早晨：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I carry an umbrella, and my friend wears a raincoat. The road is wet, but our classroom is warm. The path near the school gate is slippery, so we walk slowly.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about getting your shoes ready. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 準備好上學穿的鞋：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I clean my shoes, and my brother ties his laces. My shoes are old, but they are still comfortable. I put them near the door because I need them early tomorrow.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about sharing a bedroom. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 和家人共用臥室：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My brother has a bed, and I have a small desk. Our room is small, but we each have a shelf. I use headphones because my brother studies in the same room.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a useful study desk. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 好用的讀書桌：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My desk holds my books, and my lamp lights the page. The desk is small, but it has space for my notebook. I keep it tidy because my homework needs a clear space.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about organizing a bookshelf. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 整理書架：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I put textbooks on one shelf, and I put stories on another. Some books are old, but I still use them for practice. I use a different book for each class, so I arrange them by subject.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about doing laundry in the dormitory. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在宿舍洗衣服：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I wash my clothes, and my roommate hangs her shirts outside. The laundry room is busy, but one machine is free. We wash early because many students use the room after lunch.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about cleaning your room. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 打掃自己的房間：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After I sweep the floor, my brother wipes the desk. Our room is small, but the shelves are dusty after a busy week. We clean it on Sunday because we have no morning classes.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using a shared kitchen. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 使用共用廚房：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I cook noodles, and my roommate prepares the bowls. The kitchen is small, but two people work there easily. We clean the table because other students use it after us.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about reading the dormitory notice board. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 閱讀宿舍公布欄：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I read the notice, and my roommate writes down the date. The message is short, but it gives an important meeting time. The manager posts changes there, so we check the board.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about keeping your room key safe. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 保管自己的房間鑰匙：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I put my key in a pocket, and my roommate keeps her key in a bag. My pocket is small, but the key fits inside. I check for my key because I need it after my evening class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about waking up for class. Use when, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 早起準備上課：用 when 說當時發生的事、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: When my alarm rings at six, I get out of bed. I feel sleepy, but I still get ready for class. I set the alarm early because the first bus leaves at seven.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a quiet evening in the dormitory. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 宿舍裡安靜的晚上：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I finish my homework, and my roommate reads a story. The hallway is noisy, but our room is quiet. We close the door because we need a calm place for study.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about calling home from your dormitory. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 在宿舍打電話回家：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍。
tasks.sample: I call my mother, and my father joins the conversation. I enjoy dormitory life, but I miss our family dinners. My family has many stories about the week, so I call every Sunday.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about looking at family photos. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 一起看家庭照片：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I show my family photo, and my friend shows a picture of her parents. My photo is old, but it brings back a good memory. I keep it on my desk because it reminds me of home.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about looking after the family dog. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 照顧家中的狗：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I put food in the bowl, and my brother brings fresh water. Our dog is small, but it enjoys a long walk. We take it outside because it needs its usual walk after breakfast.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about helping in the garden. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在花園幫忙：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My father digs a hole, and I put a plant beside it. The garden is small, but it has many colorful flowers. We work in the morning because the afternoon is very hot.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about sharing housework. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 分工做家事：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I wash the dishes, and my brother takes out the trash. We have homework, but we still help at home. Our parents are busy with work too, so we share the jobs.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using a family calendar. Use after, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 使用家庭行事曆：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After my mother writes the date, I add my exam time. Our plans are different, but we use the same calendar. We keep it in the kitchen because everyone passes that wall each day.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about practicing music. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 課後練習音樂：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I practice the piano, and my sister plays the guitar. The song is difficult, but I enjoy the sound. I practice after school because I have more time in the evening.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about playing badminton after class. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 下課後打羽毛球：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：shuttlecocks＝羽毛球；racket＝球拍。
tasks.sample: I bring my racket, and my friend brings the shuttlecocks. We are beginners, but we enjoy the game. We play after class because the school court is free at that time.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about drawing with a friend. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 和朋友一起畫畫：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I draw a tree, and my friend adds a small house. My picture is simple, but it shows my favorite place. It is a relaxing activity for us, so we draw after class.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about choosing an English story. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 選一本英文故事：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I choose a short story, and my sister borrows a novel. The story has new words, but the pictures are clear. I read one page each night because I am still a beginner.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about joining the English club. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 參加英文社團：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our leader brings a game, and we practice simple questions. I feel nervous, but the other students are friendly. I join the club because I need more English practice.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about preparing a short presentation. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 準備簡短的報告：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I make the first slide, and my partner chooses a picture. Our talk is short, but we practice it many times. We use large letters because our classmates sit at the back too.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about learning new vocabulary. Use after, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 學新的英文單字：用 after 說先後順序、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: After I write each word, my partner reads the example. Some words are easy, but others need more practice. I forget new words after class, so I keep a word list.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about practicing clear pronunciation. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 練習清楚的發音：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I listen to the recording, and I repeat the sentence. My voice is quiet, but the words are clear. I practice slowly because some English sounds are new to me.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about checking your spelling. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 檢查自己的拼字：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write the word, and my friend checks the letters. I know its meaning, but I sometimes miss a letter. I check my spelling because a small change makes a different word.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using an English dictionary. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 使用英文字典：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I find the word, and I read the example below it. The explanation is long, but the example is short. I use the example because it shows the word in a sentence.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about joining an online class. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 參加線上課程：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I turn on my computer, and my teacher opens the lesson. The screen is small, but I see the words clearly. I hear the teacher clearly there, so I sit in a quiet room.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about writing your own sentences. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 寫自己的英文句子：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write a sentence, and my friend checks the verb. My sentence is short, but it shows my idea. I start with simple words because they fit the basic pattern.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about preparing for a class test. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 準備班上的小考：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I read my notes, and my partner asks me questions. The test is tomorrow, but I already know most of the words. I go to bed early because I need rest before the test.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about taking a study break. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 讀書中間休息：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：dormitory＝宿舍；roommate＝室友。
tasks.sample: I close my book, and my roommate puts down her pen. We have more homework, but we need a short break. We walk outside because we enjoy the fresh air near our dormitory.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about finding your classroom. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 找自己的教室：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I read the map, and my friend checks the room number. The building is large, but the signs are clear. Our classroom is in a new part of the school, so we ask the office.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about buying a notebook at school. Use when, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在學校買筆記本：用 when 說當時發生的事、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: When I choose a notebook, my friend buys a pencil. The store is small, but it sells all our usual supplies. I need a new notebook because my English notes fill the old one.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about looking for a lost notebook. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 找遺失的筆記本：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: I look under my desk, and my friend checks the library. I find my pen, but my notebook is still missing. I ask our teacher because she keeps lost books in the office.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about completing a school form. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 填寫學校表格：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write my name, and the teacher checks my number. The form is short, but I read each part carefully. I ask about one box because I do not understand its meaning.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about taking a class photo. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 拍班級照片：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher holds the camera, and we stand near the school gate. The sun is bright, but the shade beside the wall is cool. Everyone fits in the picture, so we take the photo there.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about planning a small class party. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 規劃小型班級聚會：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I bring some fruit, and my classmate brings paper cups. Our party is simple, but everyone has a good time. We meet after class because all our classmates are free then.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using your student card. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 使用自己的學生證：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：librarian＝圖書館員。
tasks.sample: I show my card, and the librarian checks my name. The photo is small, but my name is clear. I carry the card every day because I use it at the library.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about your first nursing lesson. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 第一堂護理課：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher explains the topic, and we read a short page. Some words are new, but the pictures are helpful. I take notes because I review the lesson at home.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about learning in the practice room. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 在練習教室學習：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher shows the model, and we watch from beside the bed. The task looks simple, but it needs careful practice. This is our first nursing lesson in the room, so we ask questions.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about learning from your instructor. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 跟指導老師學習：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：instructor＝指導老師。
tasks.sample: Our instructor explains the task, and I write down the steps. I feel nervous, but she gives clear instructions. I ask about a word because I do not understand it yet.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about practicing with a classmate. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 和同學練習：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My partner reads the instructions, and I prepare my notebook. We remember most steps, but we still check the list. We ask our teacher for help because one part is new to us.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about identifying classroom equipment. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 認識教室器材：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：thermometer＝體溫計。
tasks.sample: Our teacher holds a thermometer, and my partner writes its name. The word is long, but we practice it slowly. I draw a small picture because I remember words with pictures.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about visiting a hospital with your class. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 和班上同學參觀醫院：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：lobby＝大廳。
tasks.sample: Our teacher leads the group, and a nurse greets us in the lobby. The hospital is busy, but our guide answers our questions. We do not know the building well, so we stay with the group.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about finding the hospital entrance. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 找到醫院入口：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I read the sign, and my teacher points to the main entrance. The building is large, but the main sign clearly marks the entrance. We meet by the door because our whole class starts the tour there.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about reading a hospital map. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 看醫院地圖：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：clinic＝門診。
tasks.sample: I read the floor plan, and my classmate finds the clinic. The map is detailed, but its main colors are clear. We check our location because the hospital has several buildings.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about asking for directions at reception. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 在醫院櫃檯問路：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: A visitor asks a question, and the volunteer shows a map. The visitor speaks softly, but the volunteer listens carefully. I watch the conversation because it is part of my hospital English lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about a lesson at the hospital. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 在醫院上課：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：notebook＝筆記本。
tasks.sample: My teacher shows a picture, and we discuss the English words. The room is busy, but we have a quiet corner for our lesson. I need a record of the new words, so I bring my notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about introducing yourself politely. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 有禮貌地介紹自己：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：badge＝名牌。
tasks.sample: I say my name, and my partner introduces herself. I speak slowly, but my meaning is clear. I show my student badge because it shows my role on this visit.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about reviewing placement notes. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 複習實習筆記：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：role play＝角色扮演。
tasks.sample: I read my notes, and my teacher checks the new words. Some words are long, but I remember their meanings. I review them after class because I use them in our next role play.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about observing a waiting room. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 觀察醫院等候區：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: A visitor reads a book, and another visitor checks the sign. The room is full, but the doorway is clear. I wait beside my teacher because our tour continues after a short break.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about meeting the hospital team. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 認識醫院團隊：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher introduces the nurse, and we tell her our names. She has a busy morning, but she still welcomes our group. She spends time on our student visit, so we thank her.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about describing a practice patient room. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 描述練習情境的病房：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: The room has a bed, and a chair stands beside the window. The room is small, but the doorway is clear. I describe the furniture because this is our classroom English task.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about understanding a visitor's question. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 理解訪客的問題：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：clinic＝門診；volunteer＝志工。
tasks.sample: The visitor asks for the clinic, and the volunteer checks the map. I hear the question, but one word is new to me. I ask my teacher later because one part of the conversation is unclear.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about practicing a patient conversation. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 練習病人對話：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My partner plays a patient, and I play a student nurse. I know the greeting, but I need help with the next question. We practice the conversation because polite English is part of our lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about greeting people in English. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 用英文問候別人：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I greet my teacher, and she asks about my morning. My answer is short, but I speak clearly. These greetings are useful in new conversations, so I practice them every day.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about listening to a nursing dialogue. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 聽護理情境對話：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher plays the recording, and I listen to the short dialogue. I understand the greeting, but I miss the room number. I listen again because the number is part of our practice question.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about learning hospital signs. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 學習醫院標示：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I read the sign, and my teacher points to the arrow. The English word is new, but the picture gives me a clue. I copy the word because it appears on many hospital doors.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about visiting the school health office. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 參觀學校健康中心：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: Our teacher introduces the school nurse, and we say hello. The office is small, but it has a space for our group. We visit the office because our lesson is about people at school.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about using a practice checklist. Use and, but, and so.
tasks.zh: 使用練習清單：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、so 接結果，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。小字典：checklist＝檢查清單。
tasks.sample: I read the checklist, and my partner marks our finished items. We know the activity, but we still follow the teacher's instructions. It shows every step, so we use the list.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about working toward your English goal. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 朝英文目標前進：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I study nursing, and I practice English every day. My English is still simple, but I learn a little more each day. I practice useful sentences because my goal is a nursing job in America.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about writing to an American pen pal. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 寫信給美國筆友：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: I write about my school, and my pen pal tells me about her school. We live far apart, but we enjoy the same music. I check my sentences because a clear message is important to me.

tasks.prompt: Write three sentences about learning from a nursing role model. Use and, but, and because.
tasks.zh: 向護理榜樣學習：用 and 接同方向的想法、but 接轉折、because 說原因，各寫一句。兩邊的意思要接得起來，三句合計至少 25 字。
tasks.sample: My aunt works as a nurse, and she tells me about her studies. Her job is demanding, but she enjoys her work with the team. I ask her about English because English is part of my nursing goal.

grammar.title: 連接想法：and、but、so、because、時間與條件
points: and 接同方向的想法，but 表示轉折，so 接結果；兩邊都先想成完整句子，再連起來。
because 後面接原因；同一句不要寫 Because…so…，選一種連法就好。
when 表示「當……時」，before 表示「在……之前」，after 表示「在……之後」；後面接完整句子，放句首時先用逗號隔開。
should＋原形動詞表示建議；if＋現在式句子表示條件，例如 If you feel dizzy, you should sit down.。

examples.en: My sister studies nursing, and I study English.
examples.zh: 我姊姊讀護理，而我讀英文。

examples.en: I am tired, but I finish my homework.
examples.zh: 我很累，但我把作業做完。

examples.en: I missed the bus, so I was late.
examples.zh: 我錯過公車，所以遲到了。

examples.en: When class ends, I go home because I like reading there.
examples.zh: 下課時我回家，因為我喜歡在那裡閱讀。（like 後面接動作時，可用動詞加 -ing，例如 reading。）

examples.en: If you feel dizzy, you should sit down.
examples.zh: 如果你覺得頭暈，就應該坐下。

mistakes.bad: Because I was sick, so I stayed home.
mistakes.good: I stayed home because I was sick.
mistakes.why: 英文這種原因句選 because 或 so 其中一種，不要兩個一起接。
should 後面直接用原形動詞 rest，不加 to。

stages.name: ⑥ 三到五句的小短文
stages.goal: 把三到五個簡單句照先後順序排好，寫出一件事的步驟。
criteria: 寫三到五句，步驟依實際先後順序排列
用 First、Then、After that、Finally 幫讀者跟上順序
每一步說清楚誰做了什麼，時態一致
護理情境內容正確，整題至少 40 字

grammar.title: 照順序寫：First、Then、After that、Finally
points: First 寫第一步，Then／After that 寫接下來，Finally 寫最後一步；放句首時，後面先加逗號。
每一步都是完整的「主詞＋動詞」：First, I wash my hands.，不要只剩 First, my hands.；平常流程用現在式，昨天的一次經驗用過去式，全段時間一致。
一句先說一個步驟；兩個緊接的動作可以用 and 連起來，不塞不相關的事。to＋原形動詞可以說目的，例如 I read the text to check my answers.（我讀文字來核對答案。）
before／after／without 後面可接名詞，也可接動詞 -ing：before class（上課前）、after reading（讀完後）、without looking（不看）；After that 的 that 指前面剛做的事。

examples.en: First, I get up at six.
examples.zh: 首先，我六點起床。

examples.en: Then, I wash my face.
examples.zh: 接著，我洗臉。

examples.en: After that, I eat breakfast in my room.
examples.zh: 在那之後，我在房間吃早餐。

examples.en: Finally, I check my bag and go to school.
examples.zh: 最後，我檢查書包，然後去學校。

mistakes.why: 步驟也要寫出誰做什麼，補上 I eat 才是完整句子。

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your morning before school. Use First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 用四句寫上學前的早晨，依序用 First、Then、After that、Finally。各句寫清楚活動和時間或地點，合計至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I get up at six and drink some water in my room. Then, I wash my face and brush my teeth in the bathroom. After that, I eat breakfast with my roommate at seven. Finally, I check my school bag and walk to class.

tasks.prompt: Write five sentences about washing your hands with soap at home. Describe the steps in order.
tasks.zh: 寫五句「在家用肥皂洗手」的步驟：濕手、抹肥皂、搓洗所有部位至少 20 秒、沖淨、擦乾。20 秒是搓洗時間，不是整個洗手過程；fingers 是手指，nails 是指甲。
tasks.sample: First, I wet my hands with clean running water and add soap. Then, I rub all parts of my hands for at least twenty seconds. I clean between my fingers and under my nails too. After that, I rinse my hands with clean running water. Finally, I dry them with a clean towel.

tasks.prompt: Write five sentences about a nurse checking a seated patient's blood pressure. Describe quiet rest, body position, the cuff, and the readings.
tasks.zh: 用五句描述坐姿量血壓：先安靜休息至少 5 分鐘，背有支撐、雙腳平放不交叉；尺寸合適的壓脈帶（cuff）放裸露上臂，手臂支撐在心臟高度；測量時不動、不說話，兩次量測間隔至少 1 分鐘。另留意量測前 30 分鐘避免咖啡因、運動與吸菸，並先排空膀胱。
tasks.sample: First, the patient sits quietly for at least five minutes with back support and both feet flat on the floor. Then, the nurse puts a cuff of the correct size on the bare upper arm. After that, the arm rests on a table at heart level. The patient stays still and does not talk during the measurement. Finally, the nurse waits one minute and takes another reading.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about checking a patient's identity with your teacher before care. Describe the steps in order.
tasks.zh: 用四句寫在老師指導下確認病人身分：請病人說完整姓名和出生日期，核對手圈與照護紀錄；資料不符就停下來請護理師協助，不用床號代替身分。date of birth＝出生日期；wristband＝手圈；match＝相符。
tasks.sample: First, I greet the patient and say my name. Then, I ask for the patient's full name and date of birth. After that, my teacher and I compare both details with the patient's wristband and care record. Finally, we stop and ask the nurse for help if the details do not match.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for packing for a nursing class. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「準備護理課的書包」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I check the subject on my class schedule at my desk. Then, I put the correct textbook beside my notebook in my bag. After that, I add two pens to the small pocket at the front. Finally, I close my bag after a final look at the list.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for borrowing a library book. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「到圖書館借書」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I write the name of the nursing book in my notebook. Then, I look for its shelf number on the library computer. After that, I find the book on the shelf near the back window. Finally, I borrow the book with my student card at the desk.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for reviewing new English words. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「複習新的英文單字」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I choose five words from the first page of my notebook. Then, I read each word aloud at my quiet study desk. After that, I cover the English words and write them from memory on a clean page. Finally, I check my answers against the words in the book.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for doing a listening exercise. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「完成一個聽力練習」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I open a short English recording on my phone after class. Then, I listen to the whole recording in my quiet dorm room. After that, I write three words from the recording in my notebook. Finally, I read the text beside the recording to check my words.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for taking notes in a lecture. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「上課做筆記」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I write the date at the top of a fresh page. Then, I listen to the main idea in the teacher's short explanation. After that, I record three important points below the title in my notebook. Finally, I check my notes with a classmate after the lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for planning a study afternoon. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.
tasks.zh: 寫「安排下午的讀書順序」平常怎麼做：四句、現在式。把準備、主要動作和最後收尾依序寫清楚，至少 40 字。
tasks.sample: First, I list the three assignments for the afternoon on plain paper. Then, I choose the first assignment from the top of my list. After that, I finish one small part at my desk before a break. Finally, I mark the finished work on the list in my notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write four sentences about your usual routine for getting ready for a group meeting. Show the steps in order with First, Then, After that, and Finally.

I silenced the notifications on my phone before the study session. Finally, I started the first small task on my study list.

tasks.prompt: Write five sentences about a problem with planning a campus walk. Say how you started, what went wrong, what you did next, and how you finished.
tasks.zh: 寫「安排校園散步的路線」遇到小問題的經驗。用五句依序交代開始、問題、處理方法和後續；全段用過去式，至少 40 字。情境參考：Rain started near the main entrance during the afternoon。
tasks.sample: First, I checked the weather before a short walk around the campus. Then, rain started near the main entrance during the afternoon. After that, I returned to the dormitory through the covered walkway. I told my roommate about the rain outside our building. Finally, I changed my plan and read a book in my room.

tasks.prompt: Write five sentences about a problem with practising a self-introduction. Say how you started, what went wrong, what you did next, and how you finished.
tasks.zh: 寫「練習英文自我介紹」遇到小問題的經驗。用五句依序交代開始、問題、處理方法和後續；全段用過去式，至少 40 字。情境參考：I forgot the last sentence during the first practice round。
tasks.sample: First, I wrote my name and course on a small note card. Then, I forgot the last sentence during the first practice round. After that, I read the note card again before a second try. I practised the introduction aloud in my room after class. Finally, I said the introduction to a classmate without the note card.

stages.name: ⑦ 一段
stages.goal: 主題句 → 三個支持 → 結論
criteria: 主題句：第一句說出整段要講什麼
支持句：至少三個理由或例子
結論句：最後一句收尾
連接詞讓句子接得順（First、Also、Because、So）
文法正確

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph: Why do you want to be a nurse?
tasks.zh: 寫一段：你為什麼想當護理師？
tasks.sample: I want to be a nurse for three reasons. First, I like helping people, especially older people like my grandmother. Also, nursing is a job that I can do in many countries, so it can help me reach my dream of working in the United States. Finally, I enjoy learning about the human body. For these reasons, I believe nursing is the right job for me.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about a healthy habit you have or want to have.
tasks.zh: 寫一段：你有或想培養的一個健康習慣。
tasks.sample: One healthy habit I want to have is walking every day. First, walking is free and easy, so I do not need a gym or special equipment. Also, it helps me relax after class and sleep better at night. In addition, I can listen to English podcasts while I walk, so I practice English at the same time. That is why I plan to walk for thirty minutes every evening after dinner.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph describing your favorite place to study.
tasks.zh: 寫一段：描述你最喜歡讀書的地方。
tasks.sample: My favorite place to study is the school library. First, it is very quiet, so I can focus on my notes for a long time. Second, there are many books and computers that I can use for free. Also, the chairs are comfortable, and the light is bright enough for reading. Finally, my classmates study there too, so I can ask them questions. Because of this, I go to the library almost every day after class.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a short daily study list. Take this position: "A short study list helps me begin my work after class." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short study list helps me begin my work after class. First, a short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. Also, I can mark each finished task on the paper, and this shows my progress during a busy day. In addition, the list also helps me tell a study partner the time for our shared task. For example, yesterday I put three English tasks on my list. I finished the first two before dinner and checked the last one after dinner. For these reasons, I believe a short study list helps me begin my work after class.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying in the school library. Take this position: "Our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study. First, the quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. Also, I can use the nursing books on the shelves and check unfamiliar words in the same place. In addition, the large tables give me room for my textbook and notebook on the same surface. For example, last Monday I reviewed a nursing chapter near the library window. I found a useful picture in another book and understood the lesson. That is why I am sure our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying with a partner. Take this position: "A study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson. First, a partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. Also, we can ask each other questions, so we notice gaps in our knowledge before the next class. In addition, we take turns as speaker and listener, so both students get time for active practice. For example, last week my classmate asked me five questions about body parts. I missed two answers, so we checked the textbook together after class. All in all, I think a study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about managing phone notifications during study. Take this position: "Silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session. First, each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. Also, a quiet phone gives me one clear task at a time and helps me finish a small reading exercise. In addition, a planned message break also helps me keep social conversation separate from my written homework. For example, yesterday I silenced my phone for twenty minutes at my desk. I finished one English page and checked my messages during my break. In short, silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a paper notebook for English. Take this position: "A small paper notebook is useful for my English learning." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a small paper notebook is useful for my English learning. First, I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. Also, the notebook opens quickly on my desk, so I can review a few words without checking other apps. In addition, a paper page also gives me space to connect related words with arrows and small drawings. For example, last Friday I drew a hand beside the word hand in my notebook. I covered the word and remembered it during my evening review. So, in my experience, a small paper notebook is useful for my English learning.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about doing a short evening review. Take this position: "A short evening review fits my life as a nursing student." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short evening review fits my life as a nursing student. First, the lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. Also, a small review task fits before dinner and gives me a clear place to start the next lesson. In addition, an evening review also gives me questions for the teacher before the next morning arrives. For example, yesterday I read five English sentences before dinner in my dormitory. I corrected one verb in my notebook and asked about it the next day. To sum up, a short evening review fits my life as a nursing student.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about speaking English aloud. Take this position: "Reading English aloud is useful during my private practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that reading English aloud is useful during my private practice. First, I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. Also, my voice gives me practice with a full sentence instead of only separate words from a vocabulary list. In addition, a short spoken practice also prepares me for taking a speaking turn in our next English class. For example, last Thursday I read my introduction aloud to a classmate. I forgot the word am at first, so I practised the complete sentence again. For these reasons, I believe reading English aloud is useful during my private practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using colour in class notes. Take this position: "A little colour makes my class notes easy to review." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a little colour makes my class notes easy to review. First, one colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. Also, a second colour marks my questions and reminds me about the parts that need another explanation from the teacher. In addition, a simple colour key also helps a classmate follow my page during our shared review. For example, last week I marked three questions in blue on my nursing notes. I found them quickly after class and asked my teacher for help. That is why I am sure a little colour makes my class notes easy to review.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a study desk tidy. Take this position: "A tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin. First, I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. Also, only one textbook stays in front of me, and this helps me keep my attention on the current subject. In addition, a clear desk also gives me enough room for written work and a notebook at the same time. For example, yesterday I put my loose papers in two folders before study. I opened the English folder and finished a short exercise at the desk. All in all, I think a tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about planning school meals. Take this position: "A simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise. First, I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. Also, I can plan the money for food before the week starts and leave enough for the bus home. In addition, a plan also lets classmates choose a meeting place for lunch before the morning class ends. For example, last Monday I planned lunch in the school dining room. I brought enough money and ate with my classmates before our afternoon nursing lecture. In short, a simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a weekly spending record. Take this position: "A small spending record helps me manage my student budget." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a small spending record helps me manage my student budget. First, the record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. Also, I notice repeated small purchases on the page and decide about them before the next school week begins. In addition, the record also helps me explain a textbook purchase clearly during a family budget conversation. For example, last week I wrote down each drink from the campus shop. The total surprised me, so I planned fewer extra drinks for the following week. So, in my experience, a small spending record helps me manage my student budget.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a group chat for class. Take this position: "A class group chat is useful for sharing school information." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a class group chat is useful for sharing school information. First, a quick message reaches classmates in different places and tells us about a changed room or meeting time. Also, we can ask about a missing handout and find the right person before the next lesson begins. In addition, the group also lets students offer help with a shared task without finding every person on campus. For example, last Thursday a classmate shared the new room number in our group. I read it on the bus and found the correct building before class. To sum up, a class group chat is useful for sharing school information.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking a teacher questions. Take this position: "Asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice. First, a question shows the teacher the part that confuses me, so the explanation can focus on my real difficulty. Also, clarification stops me from guessing about an unfamiliar task and supports learning under the teacher's supervision in class. In addition, a clear question also shows other students a useful way to ask about a similar difficulty. For example, yesterday I did not understand an instruction in the simulation room. I stopped the exercise and asked my teacher to explain it again. For these reasons, I believe asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning nursing words in context. Take this position: "Simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words. First, a sentence shows the job of a word, so I see more than a translation beside the English spelling. Also, I connect the word with a familiar class situation and practise a sentence for my own school life. In addition, the example also helps me see a useful combination of words instead of memorising one word alone. For example, yesterday I learned the word patient beside a short introduction. I changed the name in the example and practised it with my classmate. That is why I am sure simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about simulation practice with a partner. Take this position: "Partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class. First, a partner listens to my explanation and tells me about unclear words, so I can practise a complete introduction. Also, we take turns in the exercise, and both students notice the order of the teacher's instructions at the table. In addition, the teacher can also watch our exchange and check my actual words during the supervised classroom exercise. For example, yesterday my classmate acted as a patient in a supervised introduction exercise. I said my name and explained my student role before our teacher gave feedback. All in all, I think partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about writing a learning reflection. Take this position: "A short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class. First, I choose one learning point from the day, so my review has a clear focus instead of a long list. Also, I describe a difficulty and a next practice step, and this gives my next study session a purpose. In addition, a reflection also gives me a record of one successful point that I want to keep in future practice. For example, yesterday I wrote about a difficult classroom introduction after practice. I noticed one missing verb and added a short sentence for my next review. In short, a short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking notes during orientation. Take this position: "A small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher. First, I can record a meeting place or contact number quickly and find it again before the next group activity. Also, a blank page gives me space for questions about unfamiliar terms during the teacher's explanation in the orientation room. In addition, the notebook also gives me one familiar place for student reminders from different parts of the day. For example, last Monday I wrote the next meeting time in my notebook during orientation. I checked the note with my teacher before our group left the room. So, in my experience, a small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning an introduction for practice. Take this position: "A short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly. First, my name and student role tell the other person about me, so the start of our classroom conversation is clear. Also, practice helps me say these basic details without a long pause and gives my teacher a clear example to check. In addition, a familiar opening also helps me focus on the other person in our supervised exercise. For example, yesterday I practised saying my name and student role in our simulation class. My teacher checked my words and asked me to repeat one sentence clearly. To sum up, a short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking for feedback after practice. Take this position: "One clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that one clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice. First, one specific correction gives me a small task, so I have a clear practice task after the lesson. Also, I can compare my next attempt with the correction and notice a concrete change in my classroom work. In addition, a small correction also fits a short practice period between two of my regular nursing classes. For example, yesterday my teacher pointed out one unclear phrase in my introduction. I changed that phrase and practised the sentence again with a classmate after class. For these reasons, I believe one clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reviewing English during a bus trip. Take this position: "A short word review fits some of my bus trips to school." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short word review fits some of my bus trips to school. First, a few familiar words fit a short journey, so I do not need a long desk session for every review. Also, the regular bus trip gives me a place in my day for one small English task before the first class. In addition, the short review also helps me connect the morning journey with my goal for the first English lesson. For example, yesterday I sat on the bus and reviewed five familiar words on my phone. I stopped at my school stop and checked the same words after class. That is why I am sure a short word review fits some of my bus trips to school.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about preparing a bag the night before. Take this position: "Preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple. First, my books are ready beside the door, so I do not search for different notebooks during breakfast before school. Also, I have time to check the timetable carefully and notice a missing handout before a busy morning begins. In addition, a ready bag also leaves more of the shared dormitory desk free for my roommate in the morning. For example, last Monday I packed my nursing textbook after dinner. I found a missing handout and asked a classmate about it before the next morning. All in all, I think preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about setting one small English goal. Take this position: "One small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that one small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction. First, a clear goal gives me a specific practice task, so I spend the session on one sentence pattern or a few words. Also, I can check the result at the end and see one part of my progress during a busy school week. In addition, a small goal also gives a classmate or teacher a clear request for feedback at the end of practice. For example, yesterday my goal was three correct sentences with is. I wrote them at my desk and checked the verbs before dinner with my classmate. In short, one small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping old English answers. Take this position: "Old English answers help me see changes in my writing." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that old English answers help me see changes in my writing. First, an earlier answer shows a specific mistake, so I can compare it with my current sentence during review. Also, a correct revision gives me a personal example and reminds me about the explanation from the teacher at that time. In addition, old answers also give me familiar topics for writing a new response without reading an entirely new prompt. For example, last week I read an old sentence with a missing verb. I wrote a new sentence with the same pattern and checked it against the correction. So, in my experience, old English answers help me see changes in my writing.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about practising for a future nursing job in the US. Take this position: "My goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that my goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose. First, the goal connects English with work that matters to me, so even a short introduction has a clear use. Also, I learn about unfamiliar terms and prepare questions for later study instead of expecting one quick result from practice. In addition, the goal also gives me a useful topic for explaining my interests during a simple English self-introduction. For example, yesterday I practised a short student introduction for a future class conversation. I connected each sentence with my nursing goal and checked the simple verbs. To sum up, my goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about sharing an English practice plan with family. Take this position: "Sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home. First, my family knows the time for my practice, so we can arrange a short quiet period around dinner at home. Also, talking about one task makes the plan clear to me and gives my family a simple way to understand my progress.
