In addition, a shared plan also helps my family choose a suitable time for questions or conversation during my study evening. For example, last Sunday I told my mother about a ten-minute English review after dinner. She knew my plan and asked about the new words the next day. For these reasons, I believe sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a dictionary during writing. Take this position: "A dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing. First, a clear example shows the word in a sentence, so I can check its meaning and place in my own answer. Also, the spelling check prevents a guess from staying in my notebook and gives me a reliable form for later review. In addition, a dictionary also shows useful word forms, so I can check a form against the pattern in my lesson. For example, yesterday I checked the word library in a learner dictionary. I read a short example and wrote one sentence about our school library in my notebook. That is why I am sure a dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading the task before writing. Take this position: "Careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer. First, the task names the topic and the number of sentences, so I know the size and purpose of my answer. Also, I find the required grammar and keep that pattern in mind instead of writing unrelated details about another topic. In addition, the task also tells me the audience, so I can choose a suitable greeting or tone for my answer. For example, yesterday I marked the words three sentences in my English task. I wrote exactly three complete sentences and checked the required verbs beside the prompt. All in all, I think careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading a draft aloud. Take this position: "Reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems. First, a complete spoken sentence makes a missing subject or verb noticeable, so I stop and check that part of the draft. Also, I hear repeated words in nearby sentences and choose a clear revision from the language in my current lesson. In addition, a spoken check also helps me practise a smooth reading of my own ideas for a later classroom presentation. For example, yesterday I read my short introduction aloud at my desk. One sentence sounded incomplete, so I found its missing verb and corrected the sentence. In short, reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning from a corrected answer. Take this position: "A corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt. First, the correction shows a clear version of my own idea, so I can connect the explanation with my original sentence. Also, I can identify one important pattern and practise it in a new situation instead of copying the whole answer without thought. In addition, the corrected answer also gives me a record for comparing similar mistakes during later writing tasks. For example, yesterday my teacher corrected one question in my draft. I compared the word order and wrote another question about school with the same pattern. So, in my experience, a corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking a short break between study tasks. Take this position: "A short planned break fits my study routine after school." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that a short planned break fits my study routine after school. First, a break gives me a chance to leave the desk briefly and return to the next task with a clear beginning. Also, I can check my next goal during the pause and avoid moving straight into a long unplanned session on my phone. In addition, a planned pause also gives my roommate a predictable time for a short conversation without interrupting each question. For example, yesterday I closed my book after twenty minutes and stood up for a short break. Then I returned to the desk and started the next exercise. To sum up, a short planned break fits my study routine after school.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about checking classmates' practice answers. Take this position: "Peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer. First, another student reads my words without knowing my first idea, so unclear parts become easy to identify during our discussion. Also, I learn from checking a classmate's answer and compare both examples with the current lesson in our textbook. In addition, peer review also gives each student practice explaining a simple language rule in clear everyday words. For example, yesterday my classmate read my three English sentences and found a missing subject. I checked the textbook and revised the sentence before showing it to our teacher. For these reasons, I believe peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping practice patient stories fictional. Take this position: "Fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「支持這個做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: My view is that fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice. First, a fictional case gives the class a shared situation for role play without using a real person's private details. Also, I can connect a familiar sentence pattern with a nursing setting and ask the teacher about suitable words during practice. In addition, a fictional case also gives each student a fair chance to try a role with the same amount of background information. For example, yesterday our teacher gave us a fictional patient name for an introduction exercise. I practised the conversation with a classmate and kept real patient information out. That is why I am sure fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a short daily study list. Take this position: "One fixed study list is not right for every afternoon." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, one fixed study list is not right for every afternoon. First, a long class sometimes changes my free time, so a fixed plan does not fit the whole afternoon. Also, some questions need extra practice, and I want to give these difficult points enough attention at my desk. In addition, I also want space for a useful question from class instead of only tasks chosen earlier. For example, last Tuesday I needed extra help with a nursing chapter. I changed my list and studied that chapter with a classmate. All in all, I think one fixed study list is not right for every afternoon.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying in the school library. Take this position: "My dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, my dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study. First, my dormitory has my own books beside the desk, so I do not carry a heavy bag every evening. Also, I can practise English aloud in my room, but the quiet library area is not suitable for this activity. In addition, my own desk also saves a second trip across campus after the last class of the day. For example, yesterday I read a dialogue aloud at my desk after dinner. My roommate practised the answers with me and we checked our pronunciation. In short, my dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying with a partner. Take this position: "I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson. First, I read slowly at first, and I need time for the words that are new to me. Also, a partner sometimes starts another topic, so I lose my place in the paragraph during our conversation. In addition, I can also choose a personal order for the topics without agreeing on every step with someone else. For example, yesterday I reviewed a short chapter alone before our group meeting. I marked three questions and brought them to the discussion after lunch. All in all, I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about managing phone notifications during study. Take this position: "I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week. First, our teacher sometimes changes a meeting place, and I need that message before my group leaves the dormitory. Also, my family also needs a way to reach me about important arrangements during a long day away from home. In addition, some group assignments need a quick reply from each member before the work can move forward. For example, last Monday our teacher sent a new meeting time before practice. I read the message and told my roommate about the change. Because of this, I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a paper notebook for English. Take this position: "I prefer one digital notebook for my English review." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer one digital notebook for my English review. First, I carry my phone every day, so a digital note is available during short waits for the school bus. Also, I can search for an old word quickly and keep related examples together without another heavy book. In addition, a digital note also lets me enlarge the letters for a comfortable view during my review. For example, yesterday I searched my notes for the word patient on the bus. I found two class examples and read them before the next stop. For these reasons, I prefer one digital notebook for my English review.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about doing a short evening review. Take this position: "I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days. First, I often feel tired after a long school day, so careful reading takes a lot of effort at night. Also, the early morning is quiet in my room, and I can study a few notes before the first class. In addition, a morning review also gives me a small completed task before the rest of my busy schedule. For example, last Tuesday I went to bed after a busy day. The next morning I reviewed five words at my desk before breakfast with my roommate. That is why I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about speaking English aloud. Take this position: "Silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text. First, a new text contains several unfamiliar words, and I need time to understand their meaning before speaking. Also, I share a small room with another student, so quiet study respects my roommate's rest during the evening. In addition, a silent first reading also gives me space to mark the main idea before I practise individual words. For example, yesterday my roommate rested after a long class. I read a short dialogue silently and marked the words for spoken practice the next afternoon. All in all, I think silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using colour in class notes. Take this position: "Plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons. First, changing pens too often slows my writing, so I sometimes miss a useful part of the classroom explanation. Also, clear headings also organise a page, and they do not need several pens or extra time during class. In addition, one ordinary pen also costs little and fits easily into the pocket of my small school bag. For example, yesterday I used one black pen for my class notes. I wrote clear headings above each section and found the main points easily after dinner. In short, plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a study desk tidy. Take this position: "I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task. First, cleaning the whole desk takes time, and I sometimes use that time instead of starting my important homework. Also, a small space for the current book is enough for a short review between two classes on a busy day. In addition, a useful personal arrangement also lets me keep several current subjects nearby during a busy school week. For example, last Tuesday I had only ten minutes before dinner. I moved one pile of papers aside and reviewed five words on the free part of my desk. All in all, I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about planning school meals. Take this position: "I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu. First, the dining room changes some dishes each day, so my first plan is not always available at lunchtime. Also, my classes sometimes finish late, and the shop near the next classroom is more convenient during a short break. In addition, a choice at lunchtime also lets me join classmates with different plans without an earlier fixed booking. For example, yesterday our class ended late near the main entrance. I bought lunch at a nearby shop and had enough time for the next lesson. Because of this, I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a weekly spending record. Take this position: "I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase. First, writing every small amount takes attention during a busy day, and I sometimes forget one purchase in the evening. Also, a clear limit for each week is easy to remember and gives me a quick guide at the shop. In addition, a weekly limit also gives me privacy about small personal choices inside my agreed student budget. For example, yesterday I checked the money in my food envelope before buying a snack. I kept enough for lunch and the bus trip home. For these reasons, I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a group chat for class. Take this position: "I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice. First, many casual messages hide the useful information, so I need time to find the teacher's important announcement again. Also, one notice keeps dates and tasks together and helps me plan several school days with my notebook open. In addition, a weekly notice also lets my family understand the main school dates without joining our class chat. For example, yesterday I copied three dates from our weekly notice into my notebook. I checked the list before bed and prepared the right books for school. That is why I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking a teacher questions. Take this position: "I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion. First, a clear question is easy for the teacher to understand, so I first identify the exact sentence in my notes. Also, a busy teacher also helps other students, and a suitable time gives us space for a useful conversation. In addition, preparing the question also helps me distinguish a vocabulary problem from a question about the task itself. For example, last Monday I marked a difficult word during an ordinary lecture. After class I showed the sentence to my teacher and asked about its meaning. With these points in mind, I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning nursing words in context. Take this position: "A short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, a short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic. First, a new chapter contains many words, and a short list gives me a clear first view of the topic. Also, I can check basic meanings quickly on one page before reading the longer explanations in my nursing textbook. In addition, a short list also works as a simple self-test with the meanings covered during a later review. For example, last Tuesday I reviewed a short list of body parts before class. Then I found the same words in a labelled picture in our textbook. In short, a short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about simulation practice with a partner. Take this position: "I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice. First, I need a clear model for an unfamiliar task, so the first demonstration gives me an organised starting point. Also, the teacher explains the purpose of each step and answers our questions before we practise together in the classroom. In addition, the demonstration also shows the expected length of the classroom exercise before I take my first turn. For example, last week I watched our teacher demonstrate a classroom task. I wrote down two questions and asked them before my first supervised practice round. All in all, I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about writing a learning reflection. Take this position: "I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class. First, I sometimes feel tired after class, and a full reflection takes more attention than a few clear facts. Also, brief notes protect the order of events in my memory and give me material for a longer review later. In addition, short factual notes also make it easy to find a particular event during a later discussion with my teacher. For example, last Thursday I wrote three facts after a simulation lesson. At home I read them again and remembered the main correction from my teacher. Because of this, I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking notes during orientation. Take this position: "I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions. First, the official handout keeps the full instructions together, so I do not depend on a few incomplete words in my notes. Also, I sometimes miss a point during fast writing, and careful listening is important during the first explanation to our group. In addition, a shared handout also makes group discussion simple because classmates can look at the same heading together. For example, yesterday I followed the official handout during a classroom orientation exercise. I marked one unclear point and asked our teacher about it at the end. For these reasons, I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning an introduction for practice. Take this position: "I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech. First, a long memorised speech is difficult to adjust, and I sometimes forget the next line during a practice conversation. Also, simple words leave space for the other person to speak and make the exchange easy to follow in class. In addition, simple everyday words also match my current English level, so I can explain them to a new classmate. For example, last week I shortened my introduction to two clear sentences. My classmate understood my student role and answered my first question in the practice exercise. That is why I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking for feedback after practice. Take this position: "I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction. First, I need to understand the whole task, and one small language error does not explain every part of my performance. Also, a quick review also identifies a successful point and helps me keep that part during my next supervised attempt. In addition, an overall review also helps me choose the main difficulty for practice instead of the easiest detail. For example, last Tuesday my teacher reviewed my introduction and listening in a classroom exercise. We chose one phrase for practice and kept the clear opening sentence. With these points in mind, I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reviewing English during a bus trip. Take this position: "I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day. First, a busy day leaves me tired, and quiet time on the bus gives me a break between school and home. Also, a crowded journey is not a comfortable place for careful reading, so I keep the difficult task for my desk. In addition, time away from the screen also gives me a chance to notice my stop and organise the next part of my day. For example, last Friday the bus was crowded after our nursing class. I put my notebook away and reviewed the difficult page later at home. So, at this stage of my studies, I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about preparing a bag the night before. Take this position: "I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages. First, an early class message sometimes changes the room or subject, so the final check needs the latest school information. Also, I still use some books at night, and a morning check keeps the last study items in the correct bag. In addition, a morning check also helps me include items that I use at breakfast, such as my water bottle. For example, yesterday morning our teacher changed the first lesson to English. I read the message and replaced one textbook before leaving my dormitory room. All in all, I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about setting one small English goal. Take this position: "I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal. First, I do not always know the difficult part before reading, so the first look helps me choose a useful task. Also, a new example sometimes reveals a gap in my knowledge and changes the point that needs practice after class. In addition, an initial look also helps me choose a useful example from the actual lesson instead of a general idea. For example, last Thursday I planned word practice but noticed a problem with does. I chose three simple questions from the lesson and practised their sentence order. Because of this, I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping old English answers. Take this position: "I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note. First, too many loose pages make the folder difficult to search, so one useful answer sometimes disappears among repeated drafts. Also, a small organised collection is easy to review and leaves space for the newest questions from my current lessons. In addition, a short collection also gives me a useful set of examples to discuss with my teacher during a brief meeting. For example, yesterday I put five useful corrected answers in one folder. I kept the full old notes separately and used the small folder for a quick review. For these reasons, I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about practising for a future nursing job in the US. Take this position: "I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study. First, the distant goal has many parts, and thinking about all of them at once makes a small lesson feel difficult. Also, a weekly task is close to my present level and gives me a clear practice target after school. In addition, a weekly focus also makes it easy to ask my teacher for help with one clear problem in the current course. For example, last Monday I put my large goal aside for one short study session. I wrote three simple sentences and checked every subject and verb. That is why I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about sharing an English practice plan with family. Take this position: "I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook. First, a detailed plan changes during a busy school week, and I do not want every small change to become another discussion. Also, I need space to notice my own difficulties and adjust the practice to the lesson in front of me. In addition, my own notebook also keeps unfinished ideas private while I work out a clear plan for the week. For example, yesterday I changed a vocabulary review to question practice in my notebook. I completed the new task and told my family about the result after dinner. With these points in mind, I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a dictionary during writing. Take this position: "I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work. First, looking up every word interrupts my thought, so I sometimes lose the main point of the sentence on the page. Also, familiar words match my current level and help me practise a complete idea without a long search for difficult expressions. In addition, a first draft also shows my teacher the language that I can currently use without extra help. For example, last Tuesday I wrote a short paragraph with simple words first. Then I checked two uncertain words and kept the rest of the draft clear. So, at this stage of my studies, I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading the task before writing. Take this position: "I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning. First, a long prompt sometimes feels difficult at first, and repeated reading without a small plan does not solve every unclear part. Also, a simple list of required points gives me a clear guide and helps me return to the task during writing. In addition, a quick planning list also gives me room to organise the order of ideas before I write full sentences. For example, last Thursday I read the prompt once and listed its three requirements. I checked each item again during my draft and asked about one unfamiliar word. All in all, I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading a draft aloud. Take this position: "I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud. First, a sentence sometimes sounds smooth but says the wrong thing, so I first compare the meaning with the writing task. Also, a silent check also respects other students in the library and gives me a quiet way to review the whole paragraph. In addition, a silent review also gives me time to compare the order of ideas with the paragraph plan beside the draft. For example, last Monday I checked a paragraph silently in the library. I noticed an unrelated detail and removed it before practising the revised paragraph aloud at home. Because of this, I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning from a corrected answer. Take this position: "I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer. First, an immediate full answer makes copying easy, and I sometimes miss the reason for the change during a quick review. Also, one independent correction gives me a chance to use the lesson and shows the exact point that still needs help. In addition, the extra attempt also fits a short independent task before my study partner arrives for our shared review. For example, last Tuesday I checked the verb after does in my own question. Then I read the teacher's correction and confirmed the change in a second sentence. For these reasons, I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking a short break between study tasks. Take this position: "I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break. First, a break in the middle of one short question breaks the flow, and I need time to remember my place again. Also, a finished task gives me a clear stopping point and lets me begin the next section without an unfinished sentence nearby. In addition, a completed section also makes it easy to record progress on my list before I leave the desk. For example, last Thursday I finished the last two lines of a paragraph before my break. After the pause I opened a new page and began another task. That is why I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about checking classmates' practice answers. Take this position: "I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone. First, a new grammar point confuses both students sometimes, and two similar guesses do not make an answer correct in class. Also, the teacher explains the rule clearly and connects the correction with the pattern in our current lesson on the board. In addition, teacher feedback also gives the whole class one shared explanation for later practice with the same pattern. For example, last week my partner and I disagreed about a question. We asked our teacher and wrote down the explanation beside the example in our notebooks. With these points in mind, I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping practice patient stories fictional. Take this position: "I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: For my daily study, I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern. First, a new language pattern already needs attention, and unfamiliar clinical words add another difficult part to the first attempt. Also, daily situations use words from my earlier lessons, so I can focus on the subject and verb in the sentence. In addition, a familiar first example also gives me a useful sentence for ordinary conversation outside the nursing classroom. For example, last Monday I practised three questions about my school timetable first. After checking the question order, I tried a fictional classroom role play with my teacher. So, at this stage of my studies, I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a short daily study list. Take this position: "A study list is useful with room for small changes." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a study list is useful with room for small changes. First, a short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. Also, some questions need extra practice, and I want to give these difficult points enough attention at my desk. In addition, a small plan gives my roommate a clear idea of the time for our shared desk. For example, yesterday I listed three tasks before lunch. One difficult question took extra time, so I moved one small task to another day. So, in my experience, a study list is useful with room for small changes.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying in the school library. Take this position: "I need different study places for different kinds of homework." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, I need different study places for different kinds of homework. First, the quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. Also, I can practise English aloud in my room, but the quiet library area is not suitable for this activity. In addition, the choice of place also depends on the books and equipment for that particular assignment. For example, yesterday I read quietly in the library after lunch. Later I returned to my room and practised the same lesson aloud with a classmate. Because of this, I need different study places for different kinds of homework.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about studying with a partner. Take this position: "Partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study. First, a partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. Also, individual study gives me time to read new words slowly, so I bring clear questions to our later discussion. In addition, a short shared meeting also fits between our different class schedules without a long daily appointment. For example, last week I read my notes alone for ten minutes. Then I met a classmate and we discussed the three points that confused me. For these reasons, I believe partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about managing phone notifications during study. Take this position: "I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages. First, each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. Also, my family also needs a way to reach me about important arrangements during a long day away from home. In addition, a clear plan also tells classmates the best time for ordinary questions about our group work. For example, yesterday I silenced social messages but kept the class group available. I checked the group at my break and returned to my English page. That is why I am sure I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a paper notebook for English. Take this position: "Paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review. First, I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. Also, I can search for an old word quickly and keep related examples together without another heavy book. In addition, the two methods also give me a choice of material for different places in my school day. For example, yesterday I drew a picture in my paper notebook during class. After dinner I copied the difficult word into my phone for later review. All in all, I think paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about doing a short evening review. Take this position: "A flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit. First, the lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. Also, the early morning is quiet in my room, and I can study a few notes before the first class. In addition, a flexible time also lets me arrange one shared review with a classmate during the week. For example, yesterday I reviewed three easy sentences after dinner. I left one difficult question in my notebook for a quiet review the next morning. In short, a flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about speaking English aloud. Take this position: "I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study. First, I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. Also, I share a small room with another student, so quiet study respects my roommate's rest during the evening. In addition, using both methods also makes it easy to share the lesson with classmates in different study places. For example, yesterday I first read a new dialogue silently at my desk. Later I practised its short questions aloud in an empty classroom with a friend. All in all, I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using colour in class notes. Take this position: "A few colours for key points are enough for my class notes." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a few colours for key points are enough for my class notes. First, one colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. Also, clear headings also organise a page, and they do not need several pens or extra time during class. In addition, a simple system also stays easy to use during both quick lectures and slow home reviews. For example, yesterday I wrote most notes with one pen during class. After class I added one colour to the two questions that needed more practice. To sum up, a few colours for key points are enough for my class notes.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a study desk tidy. Take this position: "A clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room. First, I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. Also, a small space for the current book is enough for a short review between two classes on a busy day. In addition, a small clear area also makes it easy to share the desk with my roommate at an agreed time. For example, yesterday I cleared one part of my desk for English. I finished my task first and sorted the remaining papers during a later break. For these reasons, I believe a clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about planning school meals. Take this position: "A flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule. First, I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. Also, my classes sometimes finish late, and the shop near the next classroom is more convenient during a short break. In addition, a flexible plan also keeps the spending limit clear without fixing every dish in advance. For example, yesterday I planned a simple lunch budget before school. After class I checked the menu and chose an available meal within that amount. That is why I am sure a flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping a weekly spending record. Take this position: "I record important purchases and check my total at the weekend." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, I record important purchases and check my total at the weekend. First, the record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. Also, a clear limit for each week is easy to remember and gives me a quick guide at the shop. In addition, a short weekly check also gives me a chance to prepare for an unusual expense in the next week. For example, last week I wrote down a new textbook and my transport costs. On Sunday I checked the remaining money and planned the next week. With these points in mind, I record important purchases and check my total at the weekend.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a group chat for class. Take this position: "A class chat works well with clear topics and short messages." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a class chat works well with clear topics and short messages. First, a quick message reaches classmates in different places and tells us about a changed room or meeting time. Also, one notice keeps dates and tasks together and helps me plan several school days with my notebook open. In addition, a short chat summary also gives absent classmates a clear starting point for catching up on class arrangements. For example, yesterday our group put the room change in one short message. We kept casual conversation separate, so every student found the new room number quickly. In short, a class chat works well with clear topics and short messages.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking a teacher questions. Take this position: "Immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter. First, a question shows the teacher the part that confuses me, so the explanation can focus on my real difficulty. Also, a busy teacher also helps other students, and a suitable time gives us space for a useful conversation. In addition, a suitable question plan also leaves room for classmates to take their own turn with the teacher. For example, yesterday I stopped a simulation exercise and asked my teacher about an unclear safety step. Later I wrote a separate vocabulary question in my notebook for our discussion. So, in my experience, immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning nursing words in context. Take this position: "A few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic. First, a sentence shows the job of a word, so I see more than a translation beside the English spelling. Also, I can check basic meanings quickly on one page before reading the longer explanations in my nursing textbook. In addition, this order also gives me a small set of examples for sharing practice with a classmate. For example, yesterday I checked five new words on a small list. After that I read one simple example for each word and said the examples aloud. To sum up, a few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about simulation practice with a partner. Take this position: "A teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning. First, a partner listens to my explanation and tells me about unclear words, so I can practise a complete introduction. Also, the teacher explains the purpose of each step and answers our questions before we practise together in the classroom. In addition, the combination also gives our group a common set of words for discussing feedback after practice. For example, yesterday I watched the teacher's introduction first. Then I practised a short introduction with a classmate and asked the teacher about one unclear phrase. For these reasons, I believe a teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about writing a learning reflection. Take this position: "Brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine. First, I choose one learning point from the day, so my review has a clear focus instead of a long list. Also, brief notes protect the order of events in my memory and give me material for a longer review later. In addition, a two-step reflection also separates the order of events from my personal feelings about the lesson. For example, yesterday I wrote three short facts after class without patient details. After dinner I added my feelings and one simple goal for the next lesson. That is why I am sure brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking notes during orientation. Take this position: "The official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, the official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation. First, I can record a meeting place or contact number quickly and find it again before the next group activity. Also, I sometimes miss a point during fast writing, and careful listening is important during the first explanation to our group. In addition, the two sources also help me separate official instructions from my own questions for the teacher. For example, yesterday I followed the orientation handout with my classmates. I wrote one personal question beside a heading and checked the answer with our teacher. All in all, I think the official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning an introduction for practice. Take this position: "A few key sentences make a simple introduction clear." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a few key sentences make a simple introduction clear. First, my name and student role tell the other person about me, so the start of our classroom conversation is clear. Also, simple words leave space for the other person to speak and make the exchange easy to follow in class. In addition, a simple set of key sentences also makes feedback specific because my teacher can check each part separately. For example, yesterday I practised my name and student role before simulation class. During the exercise I used those two sentences and listened to my classmate's reply. In short, a few key sentences make a simple introduction clear.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about asking for feedback after practice. Take this position: "A brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step. First, one specific correction gives me a small task, so I have a clear practice task after the lesson. Also, a quick review also identifies a successful point and helps me keep that part during my next supervised attempt. In addition, a balanced review also gives my study partner a clear point to check during our next practice together. For example, yesterday my teacher named one strength and one difficulty after our exercise. I kept the clear opening and practised the difficult question before the next round. So, in my experience, a brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reviewing English during a bus trip. Take this position: "My bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, my bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest. First, a few familiar words fit a short journey, so I do not need a long desk session for every review. Also, a crowded journey is not a comfortable place for careful reading, so I keep the difficult task for my desk. In addition, a flexible choice also avoids carrying extra books for every journey just to follow one fixed review plan. For example, yesterday the morning bus was quiet, so I reviewed three words in my seat. After class the bus was crowded, so I took a break. To sum up, my bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about preparing a bag the night before. Take this position: "An evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, an evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine. First, my books are ready beside the door, so I do not search for different notebooks during breakfast before school. Also, I still use some books at night, and a morning check keeps the last study items in the correct bag. In addition, two short checks also make it easy to separate regular materials from items needed only for one special lesson. For example, yesterday I packed my usual books after dinner. This morning I checked the class message and added the extra handout for our first lesson. For these reasons, I believe an evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about setting one small English goal. Take this position: "A short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal. First, a clear goal gives me a specific practice task, so I spend the session on one sentence pattern or a few words. Also, a new example sometimes reveals a gap in my knowledge and changes the point that needs practice after class. In addition, this order also makes it easy to explain my chosen goal in one simple sentence to a study partner. For example, yesterday I read the lesson once before setting my goal. I noticed a question pattern and chose that pattern for ten minutes of focused practice. That is why I am sure a short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping old English answers. Take this position: "A small organised review collection helps me find useful examples." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a small organised review collection helps me find useful examples. First, an earlier answer shows a specific mistake, so I can compare it with my current sentence during review. Also, a small organised collection is easy to review and leaves space for the newest questions from my current lessons. In addition, topic groups also make it easy to select one old pattern that matches my current lesson at school. For example, yesterday I chose one early answer and its corrected version for my review folder. I kept the other notes in order for later reference. All in all, I think a small organised review collection helps me find useful examples.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about practising for a future nursing job in the US. Take this position: "A long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan. First, the goal connects English with work that matters to me, so even a short introduction has a clear use. Also, a weekly task is close to my present level and gives me a clear practice target after school. In addition, a link between both goals also helps my family understand the purpose of the small tasks in my plan. For example, yesterday I wrote my long-term nursing goal at the top of my notebook. Below it I added one small task with three present-tense sentences. In short, a long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about sharing an English practice plan with family. Take this position: "A clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family. First, my family knows the time for my practice, so we can arrange a short quiet period around dinner at home. Also, I need space to notice my own difficulties and adjust the practice to the lesson in front of me. In addition, a simple family update also gives me a chance to describe one success without listing every exercise. For example, yesterday I told my family about my main goal for the week. I chose the exact evening exercise later after checking my homework and energy. So, in my experience, a clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about using a dictionary during writing. Take this position: "A simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice. First, a clear example shows the word in a sentence, so I can check its meaning and place in my own answer. Also, familiar words match my current level and help me practise a complete idea without a long search for difficult expressions. In addition, a short list of checked words also gives me useful vocabulary to review after finishing the paragraph. For example, yesterday I drafted three sentences with words from my lesson. I checked one uncertain spelling in the dictionary and read the complete answer aloud. To sum up, a simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading the task before writing. Take this position: "A full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly. First, the task names the topic and the number of sentences, so I know the size and purpose of my answer. Also, a simple list of required points gives me a clear guide and helps me return to the task during writing. In addition, the task also names the reader, so I can choose a suitable greeting or tone for the finished answer. For example, yesterday I read the whole task and marked its action words. I wrote a tiny plan beside it and checked the requirements after my first draft. For these reasons, I believe a full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about reading a draft aloud. Take this position: "A silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, a silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft. First, a complete spoken sentence makes a missing subject or verb noticeable, so I stop and check that part of the draft. Also, a silent check also respects other students in the library and gives me a quiet way to review the whole paragraph. In addition, the spoken part also gives me practice presenting my own ideas to a classmate during our next lesson. For example, yesterday I first compared my paragraph with the task in silence. After dinner I read it aloud in my room and checked one repeated word. That is why I am sure a silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about learning from a corrected answer. Take this position: "One independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, one independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn. First, the correction shows a clear version of my own idea, so I can connect the explanation with my original sentence. Also, one independent correction gives me a chance to use the lesson and shows the exact point that still needs help. In addition, the two versions also give me material for explaining one useful change to a classmate during peer review. For example, yesterday I tried to correct one verb before opening the full example. I compared the two versions and wrote a new sentence with the corrected pattern. All in all, I think one independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about taking a short break between study tasks. Take this position: "I plan breaks around clear stopping points in my homework." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, I plan breaks around clear stopping points in my homework. First, a break gives me a chance to leave the desk briefly and return to the next task with a clear beginning. Also, a finished task gives me a clear stopping point and lets me begin the next section without an unfinished sentence nearby. In addition, clear stopping points also give a study partner a clear starting time for our shared practice after individual work. For example, yesterday I planned a break after one small English exercise. The task ended at a clear point, so I returned from the break to a new page. So, at this stage of my studies, I plan breaks around clear stopping points in my homework.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about checking classmates' practice answers. Take this position: "Classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher. First, another student reads my words without knowing my first idea, so unclear parts become easy to identify during our discussion. Also, the teacher explains the rule clearly and connects the correction with the pattern in our current lesson on the board. In addition, a divided checklist also keeps classmates focused on useful feedback without pretending to know every answer. For example, yesterday my partner checked my subjects and full stops. We found one uncertain verb and asked our teacher to explain that point before changing the answer. So, in my experience, classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph about keeping practice patient stories fictional. Take this position: "Daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise." Include a topic sentence, three supporting details, and a closing sentence.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」：先寫主題句，接三個不同的支持細節（其中一個可以是實際例子），最後用一句話收尾；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: In my school life, daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise. First, a fictional case gives the class a shared situation for role play without using a real person's private details. Also, daily situations use words from my earlier lessons, so I can focus on the subject and verb in the sentence. In addition, this sequence also lets me compare two uses of the same pattern and notice differences between the two familiar contexts. For example, yesterday I first asked a classmate simple questions about school. Later we used the same question pattern in a fictional nursing exercise under our teacher's guidance. To sum up, daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise.

tasks.prompt: Write one paragraph describing a useful corner of your nursing classroom. Include a topic sentence, three concrete details, and a conclusion.
tasks.zh: 寫一段介紹護理教室裡一個實用的角落。先說它有什麼用途，再補位置、教材與使用方式三個細節，最後收回主題；至少 60 字。
tasks.sample: The reading corner in our nursing classroom is useful for a short review. First, it is near the window, so I can read my notes in a bright place. Also, the shelf has books that match our current lessons. In addition, a small table gives two students space for a quiet discussion after class. For these reasons, I often use this corner to check one difficult point before the next lesson.

grammar.title: 一段一個重點：主題句、支持句、結論句
points: 主題句先說整段重點；三個支持各補不同理由或細節，例子用來說明其中一點；結論收回主題，不加新想法。 若主題是看法，可用 My view is that＋完整句子，表示「我的看法是……」。
用 First、Also、In addition 接支持，用 For these reasons／That is why 收尾；每個支持都要有自己的內容。
that 可以在名詞後補充：a job that I can do，do 後面不再補 it；while＋完整句子表示同時發生。
比較級＋than 表示「比……」：easier than、more useful than；good 比較級是 better，less time 是較少時間。

examples.en: I want to be a nurse for three reasons.
examples.zh: 我想當護理師，有三個原因。（主題句；want to／need to＋原形動詞表示想／需要做。）

examples.en: First, I like helping people.
examples.zh: 第一，我喜歡幫助別人。（支持句；like／enjoy／prefer 後可接動詞 -ing。動詞 -ing 也能當主詞：Reading helps me learn.＝閱讀幫助我學習。）

examples.en: Also, nursing is a job that I can do in many countries.
examples.zh: 此外，護理是我能在許多國家從事的工作。（that 補充 job；can＋原形動詞表示能夠，不加 s。）

examples.en: In addition, I learn about the human body while I study nursing.
examples.zh: 另外，我讀護理時也能認識人體。（這是第三個理由；while＋完整句子表示兩件事同時發生。）

examples.en: For these reasons, I think nursing is right for me.
examples.zh: 因為這些理由，我認為護理適合我。（結論句收回主題。）

mistakes.good: I want to be a nurse.
mistakes.why: want 後面接另一個動作時，要加 to。
can 後面用原形 help，不加 s。

stages.name: ⑧ 說出意見和理由
stages.goal: 用一段話說出立場，接兩個理由和一個生活例子。
criteria: 開頭說清楚自己的看法
給兩個不同的理由，不只重複「很好」
至少一個具體例子能支持前面的理由
用連接詞把理由和例子接好，整題至少 80 字

grammar.title: 把意見說清楚：I think、because、For example
points: I think 後面接完整的一句，直接說立場：I think English is useful.；中間也可以加 that，意思一樣。
because 後面寫原因，而且要有主詞和動詞；不要只寫 because useful。
用 First、Second 分開兩個理由，也可寫 One reason is that…／Another reason is that…，that 後接完整句子；每個理由都要說明它怎麼支持你的看法。
For example 後面寫一件具體的事；最後用 In my opinion 重申看法，不突然加入第三個新理由。

examples.en: I think English is useful for nursing students.
examples.zh: 我認為英文對護理系學生有用。

examples.en: I study English because some patients speak English.
examples.zh: 我讀英文，因為有些病人說英文。

examples.en: First, English helps me understand nursing words.
examples.zh: 第一，英文幫助我理解護理單字。

examples.en: For example, I practised a short conversation yesterday.
examples.zh: 例如，我昨天練了一段簡短對話。

examples.en: In my opinion, daily practice is useful.
examples.zh: 依我看，每天練習很有用。

mistakes.bad: I am think English is useful.
mistakes.why: think 本身就是動詞；說「我認為」用 I think，不再加 am。

mistakes.good: I study English because it is useful.
mistakes.why: because 後面要有主詞和動詞，補上 it is。

tasks.prompt: Do you think English practice is useful for nursing students? Write one paragraph with your opinion, two reasons, and one example.
tasks.zh: 你覺得護理系學生練英文有用嗎？寫一段：立場、兩個理由、一個例子，最後收尾。take turns 是輪流。
tasks.sample: I think English is useful for nursing students because it helps us learn about nursing. First, many nursing books have English words, so English practice helps us understand these words. Second, some patients speak English, so simple English helps us talk to them. For example, I practise saying my name and asking simple questions in English with a classmate. We take turns after class. We also check our sentences with our teacher. In my opinion, a little English practice every day is a useful part of nursing school.

tasks.prompt: Is the school library a good place to study? Write one paragraph with your opinion, two reasons, and one example.
tasks.zh: 學校圖書館適合讀書嗎？寫一段，提出兩個理由並舉一次具體經驗。body parts 是身體部位，each other 是彼此。
tasks.sample: I think the school library is a good place to study because it is quiet. First, I do not hear my roommates' music there, so I can focus on my work. Second, the library has many nursing books, and I can read them for free. For example, last week I studied the names of body parts there with a classmate. We used a book and checked each other's answers. We finished our work before dinner. In my opinion, the library is a helpful place for nursing students.

tasks.prompt: Should nursing students ask questions during clinical practice? Write one paragraph with your opinion, two reasons, and one example.
tasks.zh: 護理學生實習時應不應該提問？用兩個理由和一個例子說明。patient safety 是病人安全；unsure 是不確定，instruction 是指示。
tasks.sample: I think nursing students should ask questions during clinical practice because patient safety comes first. First, a student does not know every hospital rule, so questions help the student learn. Second, a student sometimes feels unsure about a task, and help from a nurse is important. For example, I did not understand an instruction in practice last week. I stopped and asked my teacher for help. She explained the task again. In my opinion, questions support safe care and help students learn the correct steps.

tasks.prompt: Are short study breaks useful for you? Write one paragraph with your opinion, two reasons, and one example from your own routine.
tasks.zh: 短暫休息對你讀書有幫助嗎？用自己的生活寫一段，給兩個理由和一個例子。study break 是讀書中間的休息。
tasks.sample: I think short study breaks are useful because they help me continue with my work. First, a break gives me time for a drink of water. Second, I can rest my eyes from my notes and move around the room. For example, I studied English in my dormitory last night. After twenty minutes, I closed my book and walked around for a few minutes. Then, I returned to my desk and finished the exercise. In my opinion, a simple plan with short breaks works well for me.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a short daily study list? Practise this position: "A short study list helps me begin my work after class." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short study list helps me begin my work after class. First, a short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. Second, I can mark each finished task on the paper, and this shows my progress during a busy day. For example, yesterday I put three English tasks on my list. I finished the first two before dinner and checked the last one after dinner. That is why I believe a short study list helps me begin my work after class.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying in the school library? Practise this position: "Our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study. First, the quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. Second, I can use the nursing books on the shelves and check unfamiliar words in the same place. For example, last Monday I reviewed a nursing chapter near the library window. I found a useful picture in another book and understood the lesson. For these two reasons, I am convinced that our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying with a partner? Practise this position: "A study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson. First, a partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. Second, we can ask each other questions, so we notice gaps in our knowledge before the next class. For example, last week my classmate asked me five questions about body parts. I missed two answers, so we checked the textbook together after class. After this experience, I still think a study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson.
