tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about managing phone notifications during study? Practise this position: "Silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session. First, each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. Second, a quiet phone gives me one clear task at a time and helps me finish a small reading exercise. For example, yesterday I silenced my phone for twenty minutes at my desk. I finished one English page and checked my messages during my break. Overall, I feel that silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a paper notebook for English? Practise this position: "A small paper notebook is useful for my English learning." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a small paper notebook is useful for my English learning. First, I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. Second, the notebook opens quickly on my desk, so I can review a few words without checking other apps. For example, last Friday I drew a hand beside the word hand in my notebook. I covered the word and remembered it during my evening review. This is why I agree that a small paper notebook is useful for my English learning.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about doing a short evening review? Practise this position: "A short evening review fits my life as a nursing student." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short evening review fits my life as a nursing student. First, the lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. Second, a small review task fits before dinner and gives me a clear place to start the next lesson. For example, yesterday I read five English sentences before dinner in my dormitory. I corrected one verb in my notebook and asked about it the next day. So my answer is that a short evening review fits my life as a nursing student.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about speaking English aloud? Practise this position: "Reading English aloud is useful during my private practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think reading English aloud is useful during my private practice. First, I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. Second, my voice gives me practice with a full sentence instead of only separate words from a vocabulary list. For example, last Thursday I read my introduction aloud to a classmate. I forgot the word am at first, so I practised the complete sentence again. That is why I believe reading English aloud is useful during my private practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using colour in class notes? Practise this position: "A little colour makes my class notes easy to review." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a little colour makes my class notes easy to review. First, one colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. Second, a second colour marks my questions and reminds me about the parts that need another explanation from the teacher. For example, last week I marked three questions in blue on my nursing notes. I found them quickly after class and asked my teacher for help. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a little colour makes my class notes easy to review.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a study desk tidy? Practise this position: "A tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin. First, I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. Second, only one textbook stays in front of me, and this helps me keep my attention on the current subject. For example, yesterday I put my loose papers in two folders before study. I opened the English folder and finished a short exercise at the desk. After this experience, I still think a tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about planning school meals? Practise this position: "A simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise. First, I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. Second, I can plan the money for food before the week starts and leave enough for the bus home. For example, last Monday I planned lunch in the school dining room. I brought enough money and ate with my classmates before our afternoon nursing lecture. Overall, I feel that a simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a weekly spending record? Practise this position: "A small spending record helps me manage my student budget." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a small spending record helps me manage my student budget. First, the record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. Second, I notice repeated small purchases on the page and decide about them before the next school week begins. For example, last week I wrote down each drink from the campus shop. The total surprised me, so I planned fewer extra drinks for the following week. This is why I agree that a small spending record helps me manage my student budget.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a group chat for class? Practise this position: "A class group chat is useful for sharing school information." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a class group chat is useful for sharing school information. First, a quick message reaches classmates in different places and tells us about a changed room or meeting time. Second, we can ask about a missing handout and find the right person before the next lesson begins. For example, last Thursday a classmate shared the new room number in our group. I read it on the bus and found the correct building before class. So my answer is that a class group chat is useful for sharing school information.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking a teacher questions? Practise this position: "Asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice. First, a question shows the teacher the part that confuses me, so the explanation can focus on my real difficulty. Second, clarification stops me from guessing about an unfamiliar task and supports learning under the teacher's supervision in class. For example, yesterday I did not understand an instruction in the simulation room. I stopped the exercise and asked my teacher to explain it again. That is why I believe asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning nursing words in context? Practise this position: "Simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words. First, a sentence shows the job of a word, so I see more than a translation beside the English spelling. Second, I connect the word with a familiar class situation and practise a sentence for my own school life. For example, yesterday I learned the word patient beside a short introduction. I changed the name in the example and practised it with my classmate. For these two reasons, I am convinced that simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about simulation practice with a partner? Practise this position: "Partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class. First, a partner listens to my explanation and tells me about unclear words, so I can practise a complete introduction. Second, we take turns in the exercise, and both students notice the order of the teacher's instructions at the table. For example, yesterday my classmate acted as a patient in a supervised introduction exercise. I said my name and explained my student role before our teacher gave feedback. After this experience, I still think partner practice is useful in our supervised simulation class.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about writing a learning reflection? Practise this position: "A short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class. First, I choose one learning point from the day, so my review has a clear focus instead of a long list. Second, I also describe a difficulty and a next practice step, and this gives my next study session a purpose. For example, yesterday I wrote about a difficult classroom introduction after practice. I noticed one missing verb and added a short sentence for my next review. Overall, I feel that a short reflection helps me review my progress after nursing class.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking notes during orientation? Practise this position: "A small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher. First, I can record a meeting place or contact number quickly and find it again before the next group activity. Second, a blank page gives me space for questions about unfamiliar terms during the teacher's explanation in the orientation room. For example, last Monday I wrote the next meeting time in my notebook during orientation. I checked the note with my teacher before our group left the room. This is why I agree that a small notebook is useful during hospital orientation with my teacher.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning an introduction for practice? Practise this position: "A short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly. First, my name and student role tell the other person about me, so the start of our classroom conversation is clear. Second, practice helps me say these basic details without a long pause and gives my teacher a clear example to check. For example, yesterday I practised saying my name and student role in our simulation class. My teacher checked my words and asked me to repeat one sentence clearly. So my answer is that a short introduction helps me begin a supervised conversation clearly.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking for feedback after practice? Practise this position: "One clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think one clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice. First, one specific correction gives me a small task, so I have a clear practice task after the lesson. Second, I can compare my next attempt with the correction and notice a concrete change in my classroom work. For example, yesterday my teacher pointed out one unclear phrase in my introduction. I changed that phrase and practised the sentence again with a classmate after class. That is why I believe one clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reviewing English during a bus trip? Practise this position: "A short word review fits some of my bus trips to school." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short word review fits some of my bus trips to school. First, a few familiar words fit a short journey, so I do not need a long desk session for every review. Second, the regular bus trip gives me a place in my day for one small English task before the first class. For example, yesterday I sat on the bus and reviewed five familiar words on my phone. I stopped at my school stop and checked the same words after class. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a short word review fits some of my bus trips to school.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about preparing a bag the night before? Practise this position: "Preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple. First, my books are ready beside the door, so I do not search for different notebooks during breakfast before school. Second, I have time to check the timetable carefully and notice a missing handout before a busy morning begins. For example, last Monday I packed my nursing textbook after dinner. I found a missing handout and asked a classmate about it before the next morning. After this experience, I still think preparing my school bag at night makes my morning simple.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about setting one small English goal? Practise this position: "One small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think one small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction. First, a clear goal gives me a specific practice task, so I spend the session on one sentence pattern or a few words. Second, I can check the result at the end and see one part of my progress during a busy school week. For example, yesterday my goal was three correct sentences with is. I wrote them at my desk and checked the verbs before dinner with my classmate. Overall, I feel that one small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping old English answers? Practise this position: "Old English answers help me see changes in my writing." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think old English answers help me see changes in my writing. First, an earlier answer shows a specific mistake, so I can compare it with my current sentence during review. Second, a correct revision gives me a personal example and reminds me about the explanation from the teacher at that time. For example, last week I read an old sentence with a missing verb. I wrote a new sentence with the same pattern and checked it against the correction. This is why I agree that old English answers help me see changes in my writing.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about practising for a future nursing job in the US? Practise this position: "My goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think my goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose. First, the goal connects English with work that matters to me, so even a short introduction has a clear use. Second, I learn about unfamiliar terms and prepare questions for later study instead of expecting one quick result from practice. For example, yesterday I practised a short student introduction for a future class conversation. I connected each sentence with my nursing goal and checked the simple verbs. So my answer is that my goal of nursing in the US gives my English practice a purpose.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about sharing an English practice plan with family? Practise this position: "Sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home. First, my family knows the time for my practice, so we can arrange a short quiet period around dinner at home. Second, talking about one task makes the plan clear to me and gives my family a simple way to understand my progress. For example, last Sunday I told my mother about a ten-minute English review after dinner. She knew my plan and asked about the new words the next day. That is why I believe sharing my English plan with family gives my study a useful place at home.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a dictionary during writing? Practise this position: "A dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing. First, a clear example shows the word in a sentence, so I can check its meaning and place in my own answer. Second, the spelling check prevents a guess from staying in my notebook and gives me a reliable form for later review. For example, yesterday I checked the word library in a learner dictionary. I read a short example and wrote one sentence about our school library in my notebook. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a dictionary helps me check an unfamiliar word during English writing.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading the task before writing? Practise this position: "Careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer. First, the task names the topic and the number of sentences, so I know the size and purpose of my answer. Second, I also find the required grammar and keep that pattern in mind instead of writing unrelated details about another topic. For example, yesterday I marked the words three sentences in my English task. I wrote exactly three complete sentences and checked the required verbs beside the prompt. After this experience, I still think careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading a draft aloud? Practise this position: "Reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems. First, a complete spoken sentence makes a missing subject or verb noticeable, so I stop and check that part of the draft. Second, I hear repeated words in nearby sentences and choose a clear revision from the language in my current lesson. For example, yesterday I read my short introduction aloud at my desk. One sentence sounded incomplete, so I found its missing verb and corrected the sentence. Overall, I feel that reading my draft aloud helps me find simple sentence problems.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning from a corrected answer? Practise this position: "A corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt. First, the correction shows a clear version of my own idea, so I can connect the explanation with my original sentence. Second, I can identify one important pattern and practise it in a new situation instead of copying the whole answer without thought. For example, yesterday my teacher corrected one question in my draft. I compared the word order and wrote another question about school with the same pattern. This is why I agree that a corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking a short break between study tasks? Practise this position: "A short planned break fits my study routine after school." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think a short planned break fits my study routine after school. First, a break gives me a chance to leave the desk briefly and return to the next task with a clear beginning. Second, I can check my next goal during the pause and avoid moving straight into a long unplanned session on my phone. For example, yesterday I closed my book after twenty minutes and stood up for a short break. Then I returned to the desk and started the next exercise. So my answer is that a short planned break fits my study routine after school.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about checking classmates' practice answers? Practise this position: "Peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer. First, another student reads my words without knowing my first idea, so unclear parts become easy to identify during our discussion. Second, I also learn from checking a classmate's answer and compare both examples with the current lesson in our textbook. For example, yesterday my classmate read my three English sentences and found a missing subject. I checked the textbook and revised the sentence before showing it to our teacher. That is why I believe peer review helps me notice clear and unclear parts of a practice answer.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping practice patient stories fictional? Practise this position: "Fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「支持這個做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: I think fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice. First, a fictional case gives the class a shared situation for role play without using a real person's private details. Second, I can connect a familiar sentence pattern with a nursing setting and ask the teacher about suitable words during practice. For example, yesterday our teacher gave us a fictional patient name for an introduction exercise. I practised the conversation with a classmate and kept real patient information out. For these two reasons, I am convinced that fictional patient stories are useful for classroom English practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a short daily study list? Practise this position: "One fixed study list is not right for every afternoon." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: In my opinion, one fixed study list is not right for every afternoon. One reason is that a long class sometimes changes my free time, so a fixed plan does not fit the whole afternoon. Another reason is that some questions need extra practice, and I want to give these difficult points enough attention at my desk. For example, last Tuesday I needed extra help with a nursing chapter. I changed my list and studied that chapter with a classmate. After this experience, I still think one fixed study list is not right for every afternoon.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying in the school library? Practise this position: "My dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: In my opinion, my dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study. One reason is that my dormitory has my own books beside the desk, so I do not carry a heavy bag every evening. Another reason is that I can practise English aloud in my room, but the quiet library area is not suitable for this activity. For example, yesterday I read a dialogue aloud at my desk after dinner. My roommate practised the answers with me and we checked our pronunciation. Overall, I feel that my dormitory desk is a better choice for my evening study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying with a partner? Practise this position: "I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson. One reason is that I read slowly at first, and I need time for the words that are new to me. Another reason is that a partner sometimes starts another topic, so I lose my place in the paragraph during our conversation. For example, yesterday I reviewed a short chapter alone before our group meeting. I marked three questions and brought them to the discussion after lunch. This is why I prefer studying alone for the first review of a lesson.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about managing phone notifications during study? Practise this position: "I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week. One reason is that our teacher sometimes changes a meeting place, and I need that message before my group leaves the dormitory. Another reason is that my family also needs a way to reach me about important arrangements during a long day away from home. For example, last Monday our teacher sent a new meeting time before practice. I read the message and told my roommate about the change. So, for now, I need some phone notifications during a busy clinical week.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a paper notebook for English? Practise this position: "I prefer one digital notebook for my English review." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer one digital notebook for my English review. One reason is that I carry my phone every day, so a digital note is available during short waits for the school bus. Another reason is that I can search for an old word quickly and keep related examples together without another heavy book. For example, yesterday I searched my notes for the word patient on the bus. I found two class examples and read them before the next stop. That is why, in my view, I prefer one digital notebook for my English review.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about doing a short evening review? Practise this position: "I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days. One reason is that I often feel tired after a long school day, so careful reading takes a lot of effort at night. Another reason is that the early morning is quiet in my room, and I can study a few notes before the first class. For example, last Tuesday I went to bed after a busy day. The next morning I reviewed five words at my desk before breakfast with my roommate. For these two reasons, I prefer reviewing early in the morning on busy school days.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about speaking English aloud? Practise this position: "Silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: In my opinion, silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text. One reason is that a new text contains several unfamiliar words, and I need time to understand their meaning before speaking. Another reason is that I share a small room with another student, so quiet study respects my roommate's rest during the evening. For example, yesterday my roommate rested after a long class. I read a short dialogue silently and marked the words for spoken practice the next afternoon. After this experience, I still think silent reading is a useful first step for a difficult English text.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using colour in class notes? Practise this position: "Plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: In my opinion, plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons. One reason is that changing pens too often slows my writing, so I sometimes miss a useful part of the classroom explanation. Another reason is that clear headings also organise a page, and they do not need several pens or extra time during class. For example, yesterday I used one black pen for my class notes. I wrote clear headings above each section and found the main points easily after dinner. Overall, I feel that plain notes are enough for many of my daily lessons.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a study desk tidy? Practise this position: "I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task. One reason is that cleaning the whole desk takes time, and I sometimes use that time instead of starting my important homework. Another reason is that a small space for the current book is enough for a short review between two classes on a busy day. For example, last Tuesday I had only ten minutes before dinner. I moved one pile of papers aside and reviewed five words on the free part of my desk. This is why I do not need a perfectly tidy desk before every small task.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about planning school meals? Practise this position: "I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu. One reason is that the dining room changes some dishes each day, so my first plan is not always available at lunchtime. Another reason is that my classes sometimes finish late, and the shop near the next classroom is more convenient during a short break. For example, yesterday our class ended late near the main entrance. I bought lunch at a nearby shop and had enough time for the next lesson. So, for now, I prefer choosing my meal after I see the school menu.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a weekly spending record? Practise this position: "I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase. One reason is that writing every small amount takes attention during a busy day, and I sometimes forget one purchase in the evening. Another reason is that a clear limit for each week is easy to remember and gives me a quick guide at the shop. For example, yesterday I checked the money in my food envelope before buying a snack. I kept enough for lunch and the bus trip home. That is why, in my view, I prefer a simple weekly limit instead of recording every small purchase.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a group chat for class? Practise this position: "I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice. One reason is that many casual messages hide the useful information, so I need time to find the teacher's important announcement again. Another reason is that one notice keeps dates and tasks together and helps me plan several school days with my notebook open. For example, yesterday I copied three dates from our weekly notice into my notebook. I checked the list before bed and prepared the right books for school. For these two reasons, I prefer important class information in one clear weekly notice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking a teacher questions? Practise this position: "I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion. One reason is that a clear question is easy for the teacher to understand, so I first identify the exact sentence in my notes. Another reason is that a busy teacher also helps other students, and a suitable time gives us space for a useful conversation. For example, last Monday I marked a difficult word during an ordinary lecture. After class I showed the sentence to my teacher and asked about its meaning. After this experience, I prefer preparing a clear question before an ordinary class discussion.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning nursing words in context? Practise this position: "A short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: In my opinion, a short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic. One reason is that a new chapter contains many words, and a short list gives me a clear first view of the topic. Another reason is that I can check basic meanings quickly on one page before reading the longer explanations in my nursing textbook. For example, last Tuesday I reviewed a short list of body parts before class. Then I found the same words in a labelled picture in our textbook. Overall, I feel that a short word list is useful for my first look at a new topic.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about simulation practice with a partner? Practise this position: "I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice. One reason is that I need a clear model for an unfamiliar task, so the first demonstration gives me an organised starting point. Another reason is that the teacher explains the purpose of each step and answers our questions before we practise together in the classroom. For example, last week I watched our teacher demonstrate a classroom task. I wrote down two questions and asked them before my first supervised practice round. This is why I prefer watching the teacher carefully before my first partner practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about writing a learning reflection? Practise this position: "I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class. One reason is that I sometimes feel tired after class, and a full reflection takes more attention than a few clear facts. Another reason is that brief notes protect the order of events in my memory and give me material for a longer review later. For example, last Thursday I wrote three facts after a simulation lesson. At home I read them again and remembered the main correction from my teacher. So, for now, I prefer brief factual notes immediately after a busy class.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking notes during orientation? Practise this position: "I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions. One reason is that the official handout keeps the full instructions together, so I do not depend on a few incomplete words in my notes. Another reason is that I sometimes miss a point during fast writing, and careful listening is important during the first explanation to our group. For example, yesterday I followed the official handout during a classroom orientation exercise. I marked one unclear point and asked our teacher about it at the end. That is why, in my view, I prefer the official orientation handout for the main instructions.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning an introduction for practice? Practise this position: "I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech. One reason is that a long memorised speech is difficult to adjust, and I sometimes forget the next line during a practice conversation. Another reason is that simple words leave space for the other person to speak and make the exchange easy to follow in class. For example, last week I shortened my introduction to two clear sentences. My classmate understood my student role and answered my first question in the practice exercise. For these two reasons, I prefer a natural introduction instead of a long memorised speech.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking for feedback after practice? Practise this position: "I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction. One reason is that I need to understand the whole task, and one small language error does not explain every part of my performance. Another reason is that a quick review also identifies a successful point and helps me keep that part during my next supervised attempt. For example, last Tuesday my teacher reviewed my introduction and listening in a classroom exercise. We chose one phrase for practice and kept the clear opening sentence. After this experience, I prefer a short review of the whole exercise before choosing one correction.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reviewing English during a bus trip? Practise this position: "I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day. One reason is that a busy day leaves me tired, and quiet time on the bus gives me a break between school and home. Another reason is that a crowded journey is not a comfortable place for careful reading, so I keep the difficult task for my desk. For example, last Friday the bus was crowded after our nursing class. I put my notebook away and reviewed the difficult page later at home. Overall, I prefer resting during the bus trip after a long school day.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about preparing a bag the night before? Practise this position: "I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages. One reason is that an early class message sometimes changes the room or subject, so the final check needs the latest school information. Another reason is that I still use some books at night, and a morning check keeps the last study items in the correct bag. For example, yesterday morning our teacher changed the first lesson to English. I read the message and replaced one textbook before leaving my dormitory room. This is why I prefer checking my bag in the morning after reading class messages.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about setting one small English goal? Practise this position: "I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal. One reason is that I do not always know the difficult part before reading, so the first look helps me choose a useful task. Another reason is that a new example sometimes reveals a gap in my knowledge and changes the point that needs practice after class. For example, last Thursday I planned word practice but noticed a problem with does. I chose three simple questions from the lesson and practised their sentence order. So, for now, I prefer exploring a short lesson before choosing the day's main goal.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping old English answers? Practise this position: "I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note. One reason is that too many loose pages make the folder difficult to search, so one useful answer sometimes disappears among repeated drafts. Another reason is that a small organised collection is easy to review and leaves space for the newest questions from my current lessons. For example, yesterday I put five useful corrected answers in one folder. I kept the full old notes separately and used the small folder for a quick review. That is why, in my view, I prefer a small selection of old answers instead of every rough note.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about practising for a future nursing job in the US? Practise this position: "I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study. One reason is that the distant goal has many parts, and thinking about all of them at once makes a small lesson feel difficult. Another reason is that a weekly task is close to my present level and gives me a clear practice target after school. For example, last Monday I put my large goal aside for one short study session. I wrote three simple sentences and checked every subject and verb. For these two reasons, I prefer focusing on this week's basic lesson during daily study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about sharing an English practice plan with family? Practise this position: "I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook. One reason is that a detailed plan changes during a busy school week, and I do not want every small change to become another discussion. Another reason is that I need space to notice my own difficulties and adjust the practice to the lesson in front of me. For example, yesterday I changed a vocabulary review to question practice in my notebook. I completed the new task and told my family about the result after dinner. After this experience, I prefer keeping the details of my study plan in my own notebook.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a dictionary during writing? Practise this position: "I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work. One reason is that looking up every word interrupts my thought, so I sometimes lose the main point of the sentence on the page. Another reason is that familiar words match my current level and help me practise a complete idea without a long search for difficult expressions. For example, last Tuesday I wrote a short paragraph with simple words first. Then I checked two uncertain words and kept the rest of the draft clear. Overall, I prefer making a first attempt with familiar words before dictionary work.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading the task before writing? Practise this position: "I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning. One reason is that a long prompt sometimes feels difficult at first, and repeated reading without a small plan does not solve every unclear part. Another reason is that a simple list of required points gives me a clear guide and helps me return to the task during writing. For example, last Thursday I read the prompt once and listed its three requirements. I checked each item again during my draft and asked about one unfamiliar word. This is why I prefer a quick first look and a second task check during planning.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading a draft aloud? Practise this position: "I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud. One reason is that a sentence sometimes sounds smooth but says the wrong thing, so I first compare the meaning with the writing task. Another reason is that a silent check also respects other students in the library and gives me a quiet way to review the whole paragraph. For example, last Monday I checked a paragraph silently in the library. I noticed an unrelated detail and removed it before practising the revised paragraph aloud at home. So, for now, I prefer one silent check of the meaning before reading a draft aloud.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning from a corrected answer? Practise this position: "I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer. One reason is that an immediate full answer makes copying easy, and I sometimes miss the reason for the change during a quick review. Another reason is that one independent correction gives me a chance to use the lesson and shows the exact point that still needs help. For example, last Tuesday I checked the verb after does in my own question. Then I read the teacher's correction and confirmed the change in a second sentence. That is why, in my view, I prefer finding one error myself before reading the full corrected answer.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking a short break between study tasks? Practise this position: "I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break. One reason is that a break in the middle of one short question breaks the flow, and I need time to remember my place again. Another reason is that a finished task gives me a clear stopping point and lets me begin the next section without an unfinished sentence nearby. For example, last Thursday I finished the last two lines of a paragraph before my break. After the pause I opened a new page and began another task. For these two reasons, I prefer finishing one small task before taking a study break.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about checking classmates' practice answers? Practise this position: "I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone. One reason is that a new grammar point confuses both students sometimes, and two similar guesses do not make an answer correct in class. Another reason is that the teacher explains the rule clearly and connects the correction with the pattern in our current lesson on the board. For example, last week my partner and I disagreed about a question. We asked our teacher and wrote down the explanation beside the example in our notebooks. After this experience, I prefer teacher feedback for a grammar point that is new to everyone.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping practice patient stories fictional? Practise this position: "I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「選擇另一種做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: Personally, I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern. One reason is that a new language pattern already needs attention, and unfamiliar clinical words add another difficult part to the first attempt. Another reason is that daily situations use words from my earlier lessons, so I can focus on the subject and verb in the sentence. For example, last Monday I practised three questions about my school timetable first. After checking the question order, I tried a fictional classroom role play with my teacher. Overall, I prefer simple non-clinical examples for the first practice of a new pattern.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a short daily study list? Practise this position: "A study list is useful with room for small changes." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天列一張短讀書清單。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a study list is useful with room for small changes. First, a short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. Second, some questions need extra practice, and I want to give these difficult points enough attention at my desk. For example, yesterday I listed three tasks before lunch. One difficult question took extra time, so I moved one small task to another day. This is why I agree that a study list is useful with room for small changes.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying in the school library? Practise this position: "I need different study places for different kinds of homework." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在學校圖書館讀書。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that I need different study places for different kinds of homework. First, the quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. Second, I can practise English aloud in my room, but the quiet library area is not suitable for this activity. For example, yesterday I read quietly in the library after lunch. Later I returned to my room and practised the same lesson aloud with a classmate. So, for now, I need different study places for different kinds of homework.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about studying with a partner? Practise this position: "Partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和一位同學一起讀書。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study. First, a partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. Second, individual study gives me time to read new words slowly, so I bring clear questions to our later discussion. For example, last week I read my notes alone for ten minutes. Then I met a classmate and we discussed the three points that confused me. That is why I believe partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about managing phone notifications during study? Practise this position: "I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：讀書時的手機通知。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages. First, each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. Second, my family also needs a way to reach me about important arrangements during a long day away from home. For example, yesterday I silenced social messages but kept the class group available. I checked the group at my break and returned to my English page. For these two reasons, I am convinced that I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a paper notebook for English? Practise this position: "Paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：用紙本筆記本學英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review. First, I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. Second, I can search for an old word quickly and keep related examples together without another heavy book. For example, yesterday I drew a picture in my paper notebook during class. After dinner I copied the difficult word into my phone for later review. After this experience, I still think paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about doing a short evening review? Practise this position: "A flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：每天晚上做短時間複習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit. First, the lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. Second, the early morning is quiet in my room, and I can study a few notes before the first class. For example, yesterday I reviewed three easy sentences after dinner. I left one difficult question in my notebook for a quiet review the next morning. Overall, I feel that a flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about speaking English aloud? Practise this position: "I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把英文句子念出來。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study. First, I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. Second, I share a small room with another student, so quiet study respects my roommate's rest during the evening. For example, yesterday I first read a new dialogue silently at my desk. Later I practised its short questions aloud in an empty classroom with a friend. This is why I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using colour in class notes? Practise this position: "A few colours for key points are enough for my class notes." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在筆記中使用顏色。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a few colours for key points are enough for my class notes. First, one colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. Second, clear headings also organise a page, and they do not need several pens or extra time during class. For example, yesterday I wrote most notes with one pen during class. After class I added one colour to the two questions that needed more practice. So my answer is that a few colours for key points are enough for my class notes.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a study desk tidy? Practise this position: "A clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保持讀書桌整齊。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room. First, I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. Second, a small space for the current book is enough for a short review between two classes on a busy day. For example, yesterday I cleared one part of my desk for English. I finished my task first and sorted the remaining papers during a later break. That is why I believe a clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about planning school meals? Practise this position: "A flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：事先安排上學日的餐點。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule. First, I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. Second, my classes sometimes finish late, and the shop near the next classroom is more convenient during a short break. For example, yesterday I planned a simple lunch budget before school. After class I checked the menu and chose an available meal within that amount. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping a weekly spending record? Practise this position: "A weekly record of important purchases works well for me." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：記錄每週的花費。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a weekly record of important purchases works well for me. First, the record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. Second, a clear limit for each week is easy to remember and gives me a quick guide at the shop. For example, last week I wrote down a new textbook and my transport costs. On Sunday I checked the remaining money and planned the next week. After this experience, I still think a weekly record of important purchases works well for me.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a group chat for class? Practise this position: "A class chat works well with clear topics and short messages." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：班級群組的訊息。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a class chat works well with clear topics and short messages. First, a quick message reaches classmates in different places and tells us about a changed room or meeting time. Second, one notice keeps dates and tasks together and helps me plan several school days with my notebook open. For example, yesterday our group put the room change in one short message. We kept casual conversation separate, so every student found the new room number quickly. Overall, I feel that a class chat works well with clear topics and short messages.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking a teacher questions? Practise this position: "Immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：向老師提問。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter. First, a question shows the teacher the part that confuses me, so the explanation can focus on my real difficulty. Second, a busy teacher also helps other students, and a suitable time gives us space for a useful conversation. For example, yesterday I stopped a simulation exercise and asked my teacher about an unclear safety step. Later I wrote a separate vocabulary question in my notebook for our discussion. This is why I agree that immediate safety questions and planned vocabulary questions both matter.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning nursing words in context? Practise this position: "A few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把護理單字放進情境學。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic. First, a sentence shows the job of a word, so I see more than a translation beside the English spelling. Second, I can check basic meanings quickly on one page before reading the longer explanations in my nursing textbook. For example, yesterday I checked five new words on a small list. After that I read one simple example for each word and said the examples aloud. So my answer is that a few basic words plus simple examples help me understand a new topic.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about simulation practice with a partner? Practise this position: "A teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和同學做模擬練習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning. First, a partner listens to my explanation and tells me about unclear words, so I can practise a complete introduction. Second, the teacher explains the purpose of each step and answers our questions before we practise together in the classroom. For example, yesterday I watched the teacher's introduction first. Then I practised a short introduction with a classmate and asked the teacher about one unclear phrase. That is why I believe a teacher demonstration and partner practice support different parts of learning.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about writing a learning reflection? Practise this position: "Brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫學習反思。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine. First, I choose one learning point from the day, so my review has a clear focus instead of a long list. Second, brief notes protect the order of events in my memory and give me material for a longer review later. For example, yesterday I wrote three short facts after class without patient details. After dinner I added my feelings and one simple goal for the next lesson. For these two reasons, I am convinced that brief notes after class and a reflection later fit my study routine.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking notes during orientation? Practise this position: "The official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在實習說明時做筆記。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that the official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation. First, I can record a meeting place or contact number quickly and find it again before the next group activity. Second, I sometimes miss a point during fast writing, and careful listening is important during the first explanation to our group. For example, yesterday I followed the orientation handout with my classmates. I wrote one personal question beside a heading and checked the answer with our teacher. After this experience, I still think the official handout with a few personal questions is useful for orientation.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning an introduction for practice? Practise this position: "A few key sentences make a simple introduction clear." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習實習時的自我介紹。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a few key sentences make a simple introduction clear. First, my name and student role tell the other person about me, so the start of our classroom conversation is clear. Second, simple words leave space for the other person to speak and make the exchange easy to follow in class. For example, yesterday I practised my name and student role before simulation class. During the exercise I used those two sentences and listened to my classmate's reply. Overall, I feel that a few key sentences make a simple introduction clear.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about asking for feedback after practice? Practise this position: "A brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：練習後請老師回饋。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step. First, one specific correction gives me a small task, so I have a clear practice task after the lesson. Second, a quick review also identifies a successful point and helps me keep that part during my next supervised attempt. For example, yesterday my teacher named one strength and one difficulty after our exercise. I kept the clear opening and practised the difficult question before the next round. This is why I agree that a brief overall review helps me choose one useful next step.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reviewing English during a bus trip? Practise this position: "My bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：利用搭公車的時間複習英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that my bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest. First, a few familiar words fit a short journey, so I do not need a long desk session for every review. Second, a crowded journey is not a comfortable place for careful reading, so I keep the difficult task for my desk. For example, yesterday the morning bus was quiet, so I reviewed three words in my seat. After class the bus was crowded, so I took a break. So my answer is that my bus routine needs room for both a small review and a rest.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about preparing a bag the night before? Practise this position: "An evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：前一天晚上準備書包。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that an evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine. First, my books are ready beside the door, so I do not search for different notebooks during breakfast before school. Second, I still use some books at night, and a morning check keeps the last study items in the correct bag. For example, yesterday I packed my usual books after dinner. This morning I checked the class message and added the extra handout for our first lesson. That is why I believe an evening bag check and a morning update fit my school routine.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about setting one small English goal? Practise this position: "A short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為英文設定一個小目標。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal. First, a clear goal gives me a specific practice task, so I spend the session on one sentence pattern or a few words. Second, a new example sometimes reveals a gap in my knowledge and changes the point that needs practice after class. For example, yesterday I read the lesson once before setting my goal. I noticed a question pattern and chose that pattern for ten minutes of focused practice. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a short look at the lesson helps me choose a useful goal.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping old English answers? Practise this position: "A small organised review collection helps me find useful examples." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：保留以前寫過的英文答案。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a small organised review collection helps me find useful examples. First, an earlier answer shows a specific mistake, so I can compare it with my current sentence during review. Second, a small organised collection is easy to review and leaves space for the newest questions from my current lessons. For example, yesterday I chose one early answer and its corrected version for my review folder. I kept the other notes in order for later reference. After this experience, I still think a small organised review collection helps me find useful examples.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about practising for a future nursing job in the US? Practise this position: "A long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：為未來赴美從事護理練英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan. First, the goal connects English with work that matters to me, so even a short introduction has a clear use. Second, a weekly task is close to my present level and gives me a clear practice target after school. For example, yesterday I wrote my long-term nursing goal at the top of my notebook. Below it I added one small task with three present-tense sentences. Overall, I feel that a long-term goal and a small weekly task belong in the same plan.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about sharing an English practice plan with family? Practise this position: "A clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：和家人分享英文練習計畫。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family. First, my family knows the time for my practice, so we can arrange a short quiet period around dinner at home. Second, I need space to notice my own difficulties and adjust the practice to the lesson in front of me. For example, yesterday I told my family about my main goal for the week. I chose the exact evening exercise later after checking my homework and energy. This is why I agree that a clear main goal and flexible daily details work well for my family.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about using a dictionary during writing? Practise this position: "A simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：寫作時使用字典。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice. First, a clear example shows the word in a sentence, so I can check its meaning and place in my own answer. Second, familiar words match my current level and help me practise a complete idea without a long search for difficult expressions. For example, yesterday I drafted three sentences with words from my lesson. I checked one uncertain spelling in the dictionary and read the complete answer aloud. So my answer is that a simple first draft and a few dictionary checks suit my writing practice.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading the task before writing? Practise this position: "A full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：先讀懂題目再開始寫。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly. First, the task names the topic and the number of sentences, so I know the size and purpose of my answer. Second, a simple list of required points gives me a clear guide and helps me return to the task during writing. For example, yesterday I read the whole task and marked its action words. I wrote a tiny plan beside it and checked the requirements after my first draft. That is why I believe a full task check with a small writing plan helps me answer clearly.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about reading a draft aloud? Practise this position: "A silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：把自己寫的草稿念出來。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that a silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft. First, a complete spoken sentence makes a missing subject or verb noticeable, so I stop and check that part of the draft. Second, a silent check also respects other students in the library and gives me a quiet way to review the whole paragraph. For example, yesterday I first compared my paragraph with the task in silence. After dinner I read it aloud in my room and checked one repeated word. For these two reasons, I am convinced that a silent meaning check and spoken practice both help me improve a draft.
