tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about learning from a corrected answer? Practise this position: "One independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：從批改後的答案學習。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that one independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn. First, the correction shows a clear version of my own idea, so I can connect the explanation with my original sentence. Second, one independent correction gives me a chance to use the lesson and shows the exact point that still needs help. For example, yesterday I tried to correct one verb before opening the full example. I compared the two versions and wrote a new sentence with the corrected pattern. After this experience, I still think one independent correction and a teacher example both help me learn.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about taking a short break between study tasks? Practise this position: "Planning breaks around clear stopping points helps me study." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：在兩項讀書任務中間休息。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that planning breaks around clear stopping points helps me study. First, a break gives me a chance to leave the desk briefly and return to the next task with a clear beginning. Second, a finished task gives me a clear stopping point and lets me begin the next section without an unfinished sentence nearby. For example, yesterday I planned a break after one small English exercise. The task ended at a clear point, so I returned from the break to a new page. Overall, I feel that planning breaks around clear stopping points helps me study.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about checking classmates' practice answers? Practise this position: "Classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：互看同學的練習答案。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher. First, another student reads my words without knowing my first idea, so unclear parts become easy to identify during our discussion. Second, the teacher explains the rule clearly and connects the correction with the pattern in our current lesson on the board. For example, yesterday my partner checked my subjects and full stops. We found one uncertain verb and asked our teacher to explain that point before changing the answer. This is why I agree that classmates can check simple points and bring uncertain questions to the teacher.

tasks.prompt: What is your opinion about keeping practice patient stories fictional? Practise this position: "Daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise." Give two different reasons and one specific example in one paragraph.
tasks.zh: 主題：使用虛構病人情境練英文。這題練「按照情況調整做法」的立場。寫一段：清楚表態、兩個不同的理由、一件具體例子、結尾；至少 80 字。可以換成自己的真實經驗。
tasks.sample: My opinion is that daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise. First, a fictional case gives the class a shared situation for role play without using a real person's private details. Second, daily situations use words from my earlier lessons, so I can focus on the subject and verb in the sentence. For example, yesterday I first asked a classmate simple questions about school. Later we used the same question pattern in a fictional nursing exercise under our teacher's guidance. So my answer is that daily examples can lead to a useful fictional nursing exercise.

stages.name: ⑨ 多段
criteria: 每段有自己的工作（開頭、內容、結尾）
內容回答了題目的每一點
語氣和格式適合對象（例如 email 的稱呼和結尾）
段落之間有轉折詞
文法和用字正確

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher. You were sick and missed a class. Say sorry, explain what happened, and ask what you should study.
tasks.zh: 寫 email 給老師：你生病缺課。道歉、說明發生什麼事、問該補讀什麼。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Lin,

I am sorry that I missed your class yesterday. On Monday night I had a high fever and a bad headache, so I went to a clinic. The doctor told me to stay home and rest for one day.

I am feeling much better now, and I will come to class tomorrow. Could you please tell me which pages I should read and whether there was any homework? If there was a handout, I can get a copy from a classmate this afternoon.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Some students study late at night before tests. Is this a good idea? Write three paragraphs: your opinion, your reasons, and a conclusion.
tasks.zh: 有些學生考前熬夜讀書，好不好？寫三段：你的看法、理由、結論。
tasks.sample:
Many students stay up late to study before a test. In my opinion, this is not a good way to prepare.

First, our brain needs sleep to remember what we learned. When we sleep less, we forget new words and important details more easily. Second, tired students often feel stressed during the test, so they make careless mistakes. For example, last year I studied until 3 a.m. before a pharmacology exam, and the next morning I misread several easy questions. Third, staying up late again and again is bad for our health.

In conclusion, it is better to study a little every day and get enough sleep the night before a test. A clear mind is more useful than a few extra hours of reading.

tasks.prompt: Write to a friend about your first day of clinical practice: what you did, how you felt, and what you learned.
tasks.zh: 寫信給朋友，說你第一天實習：做了什麼、感覺如何、學到什麼。
tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

Guess what? Yesterday was my first day of clinical practice! I followed a senior nurse all day. In the morning, I checked patients' blood pressure and temperature, and I wrote the numbers on the chart. In the afternoon, I helped an elderly patient walk to the bathroom.

I was very nervous at first, and my hands were shaking when I used the blood pressure cuff. But the nurse was kind. She told me to take my time and showed me again.

I learned that it is OK to ask questions, and that patients notice when you speak to them gently. I am tired, but I am also proud of myself. I will be braver tomorrow, and I will tell you all about it!

Talk soon,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about using a short daily study list. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「每天列一張短讀書清單」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about using a short daily study list. I want to find a practical method that fits my school work and my current English level.

For example, yesterday I put three English tasks on my list. I finished the first two before dinner and checked the last one after dinner. I think a short study list helps me begin my work after class. A short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. But I also notice a difficulty: a long class sometimes changes my free time, so a fixed plan does not fit the whole afternoon. I need a clear next step for my practice this week.

Could you please tell me how I can choose three realistic tasks? I also want to know how much time I need for one review. I will write down your advice and try one small change during my next study session.

Thank you for your time and help.

Kind regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about studying in the school library. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「在學校圖書館讀書」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about studying in the school library. I hope to find a method that I can use on ordinary school days.

For example, last Monday I reviewed a nursing chapter near the library window. I found a useful picture in another book and understood the lesson. I think our school library is a useful place for my afternoon study. The quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. But I also notice a difficulty: some books stay in my dormitory, so I sometimes need to carry a heavy bag to the library. I am not sure what I should change first.

Could you please tell me which library area suits individual study? I also want to know where I can practise speaking aloud. I will try your suggestion this week and tell you how it goes.

Thank you very much for your help.

Best wishes,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about studying with a partner. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「和一位同學一起讀書」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about studying with a partner. I would like a simple method that suits my timetable and my level of English.

For example, last week my classmate asked me five questions about body parts. I missed two answers, so we checked the textbook together after class. I think a study partner helps me understand difficult parts of a lesson. A partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. But I also notice a difficulty: I read slowly at first, and I need time for the words that are new to me. I would like to know what I should try next.

Could you please tell me which questions are useful for peer review? I also want to know how we can check an answer without guessing. I will keep your advice in my notebook and use it in my next practice.

Thank you in advance for your advice.

Yours sincerely,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about managing phone notifications during study. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「讀書時的手機通知」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about managing phone notifications during study. I am looking for a realistic way to practise during a busy week of classes.

For example, yesterday I silenced my phone for twenty minutes at my desk. I finished one English page and checked my messages during my break. I think silent phone notifications help me focus during a short study session. Each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. But I also notice a difficulty: our teacher sometimes changes a meeting place, and I need that message before my group leaves the dormitory. I do not know which change would help me most.

Could you please tell me how I can organise urgent class messages? I also want to know which course notices need an immediate reply. Your advice will help me plan my next study session more carefully.

I look forward to your reply.

With thanks,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about using a paper notebook for English. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「用紙本筆記本學英文」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about using a paper notebook for English. I would like to improve this part of my study without spending hours on it every day.

For example, last Friday I drew a hand beside the word hand in my notebook. I covered the word and remembered it during my evening review. I think a small paper notebook is useful for my English learning. I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. But I also notice a difficulty: I do not carry my paper notebook on every trip, so I sometimes have no notes during a wait for the bus. I would like to fix this problem before our next class.

Could you please tell me how I can organise examples in a notebook? I also want to know which notes are useful for a short review. I will practise with your advice before our next class.

Thank you for reading my email.

Best regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about doing a short evening review. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「每天晚上做短時間複習」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about doing a short evening review. I want to find a practical method that fits my school work and my current English level.

For example, yesterday I read five English sentences before dinner in my dormitory. I corrected one verb in my notebook and asked about it the next day. I think a short evening review fits my life as a nursing student. The lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. But I also notice a difficulty: I often feel tired after a long school day, so careful reading takes a lot of effort at night. I need a clear next step for my practice this week.

Could you please tell me which lesson points need same-day review? I also want to know how I can divide review between morning and evening. I will write down your advice and try one small change during my next study session.

Thank you for your time and help.

Kind regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about speaking English aloud. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「把英文句子念出來」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about speaking English aloud. I hope to find a method that I can use on ordinary school days.

For example, last Thursday I read my introduction aloud to a classmate. I forgot the word am at first, so I practised the complete sentence again. I think reading English aloud is useful during my private practice. I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. But I also notice a difficulty: a new text contains several unfamiliar words, and I need time to understand their meaning before speaking. I am not sure what I should change first.

Could you please tell me which sentences are useful for reading aloud? I also want to know how I can check a missing word in my speech. I will try your suggestion this week and tell you how it goes.

Thank you very much for your help.

Best wishes,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about using colour in class notes. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「在筆記中使用顏色」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about using colour in class notes. I would like a simple method that suits my timetable and my level of English.

For example, last week I marked three questions in blue on my nursing notes. I found them quickly after class and asked my teacher for help. I think a little colour makes my class notes easy to review. One colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. But I also notice a difficulty: changing pens too often slows my writing, so I sometimes miss a useful part of the classroom explanation. I would like to know what I should try next.

Could you please tell me which parts of a lesson need clear headings? I also want to know how many colours are useful for a basic note page. I will keep your advice in my notebook and use it in my next practice.

Thank you in advance for your advice.

Yours sincerely,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about keeping a study desk tidy. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「保持讀書桌整齊」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about keeping a study desk tidy. I am looking for a realistic way to practise during a busy week of classes.

For example, yesterday I put my loose papers in two folders before study. I opened the English folder and finished a short exercise at the desk. I think a tidy desk makes my first study task easy to begin. I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. But I also notice a difficulty: cleaning the whole desk takes time, and I sometimes use that time instead of starting my important homework. I do not know which change would help me most.

Could you please tell me how I can prepare a desk for a short study session? I also want to know which materials I need for our next writing task. Your advice will help me plan my next study session more carefully.

I look forward to your reply.

With thanks,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about planning school meals. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「事先安排上學日的餐點」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about planning school meals. I would like to improve this part of my study without spending hours on it every day.

For example, last Monday I planned lunch in the school dining room. I brought enough money and ate with my classmates before our afternoon nursing lecture. I think a simple meal plan makes my school day easy to organise. I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. But I also notice a difficulty: the dining room changes some dishes each day, so my first plan is not always available at lunchtime. I would like to fix this problem before our next class.

Could you please tell me where the current school dining information is available? I also want to know how I can plan around a short lunch break. I will practise with your advice before our next class.

Thank you for reading my email.

Best regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about keeping a weekly spending record. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「記錄每週的花費」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about keeping a weekly spending record. I want to find a practical method that fits my school work and my current English level.

For example, last week I wrote down each drink from the campus shop. The total surprised me, so I planned fewer extra drinks for the following week. I think a small spending record helps me manage my student budget. The record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. But I also notice a difficulty: writing every small amount takes attention during a busy day, and I sometimes forget one purchase in the evening. I need a clear next step for my practice this week.

Could you please tell me how I can group regular school costs? I also want to know which simple format is useful for a weekly record. I will write down your advice and try one small change during my next study session.

Thank you for your time and help.

Kind regards,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about using a group chat for class. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「班級群組的訊息」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about using a group chat for class. I hope to find a method that I can use on ordinary school days.

For example, last Thursday a classmate shared the new room number in our group. I read it on the bus and found the correct building before class. I think a class group chat is useful for sharing school information. A quick message reaches classmates in different places and tells us about a changed room or meeting time. But I also notice a difficulty: many casual messages hide the useful information, so I need time to find the teacher's important announcement again. I am not sure what I should change first.

Could you please tell me where I can find the official weekly class notice? I also want to know which class messages belong in one summary. I will try your suggestion this week and tell you how it goes.

Thank you very much for your help.

Best wishes,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your teacher asking for advice about asking a teacher questions. Describe a recent attempt, explain one difficulty, and ask two specific questions. Use separate paragraphs and a polite ending.
tasks.zh: 寫信向老師詢問「向老師提問」。分段交代最近的一次嘗試、一個困難，提出兩個具體問題，最後禮貌收尾；至少 120 字。間接問句注意「主詞在動詞前」。
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about asking a teacher questions. I would like a simple method that suits my timetable and my level of English.

For example, yesterday I did not understand an instruction in the simulation room. I stopped the exercise and asked my teacher to explain it again. I think asking questions helps me learn during supervised nursing practice. A question shows the teacher the part that confuses me, so the explanation can focus on my real difficulty. But I also notice a difficulty: I sometimes cannot explain my question clearly, so I first identify the exact sentence in my notes. I would like to know what I should try next.

Could you please tell me when I can ask about a routine classroom question? I also want to know how I can state an unclear point precisely. I will keep your advice in my notebook and use it in my next practice.

Thank you in advance for your advice.

Yours sincerely,
Xuanye

I think simple example sentences help me learn new nursing words. A sentence shows the job of a word, so I see more than a translation beside the English spelling. But I also notice a difficulty: a new chapter contains many words, and a short list gives me a clear first view of the topic. I do not know which change would help me most.

Could you please tell me which glossary matches our current nursing chapter? I also want to know how I can check the meaning of a word in context. Your advice will help me plan my next study session more carefully.

Xuanye

But I also notice a difficulty: I need a clear model for an unfamiliar task, so the first demonstration gives me an organised starting point. I would like to fix this problem before our next class.

Xuanye

But I also notice a difficulty: I sometimes feel tired after class, and a full reflection takes more attention than a few clear facts. I need a clear next step for my practice this week.

Could you please tell me which details belong in a learning reflection? I also want to know how I can keep patient information out of personal study notes. I will write down your advice and try one small change during my next study session.

For example, yesterday my teacher pointed out one unclear phrase in my introduction. I changed that phrase and practised the sentence again with a classmate after class. I think one clear correction helps me improve after supervised practice. One specific correction gives me a small task, so I know exactly what to practise after the lesson. But I also notice a difficulty: I need to understand the whole task, and one small language error does not explain every part of my performance. I do not know which change would help me most.

Could you please tell me how I can choose one correction after practice? I also want to know when I can show you my next attempt. Your advice will help me plan my next study session more carefully.

I look forward to your reply.

With thanks,
Xuanye

I am writing to ask for advice about reviewing English during a bus trip. I would like to improve this part of my study without spending hours on it every day.

For example, yesterday I sat on the bus and reviewed five familiar words on my phone. I stopped at my school stop and checked the same words after class. I think a short word review fits some of my bus trips to school. A few familiar words fit a short journey, so I do not need a long desk session for every review. But I also notice a difficulty: a busy day leaves me tired, and quiet time on the bus gives me a break between school and home. I would like to fix this problem before our next class.

Could you please tell me which short tasks suit a quiet seated journey? I also want to know what I can review later at a desk instead. I will practise with your advice before our next class.

Thank you for reading my email.

Best regards,
Xuanye

Thank you for your time and help.

I am writing to ask for advice about setting one small English goal. I hope to find a method that I can use on ordinary school days.

For example, yesterday my goal was three correct sentences with is. I wrote them at my desk and checked the verbs before dinner with my classmate. I think one small English goal gives my daily practice a clear direction. A clear goal tells me what to practise, so I spend the session on one sentence pattern or a few words. But I also notice a difficulty: I do not always know the difficult part before reading, so the first look helps me choose a useful task. I am not sure what I should change first.

Could you please tell me how I can choose a goal at my current English level? I also want to know which exercise shows progress with that goal. I will try your suggestion this week and tell you how it goes.

Dear Ms Lin,

I am writing to ask for advice about keeping old English answers. I would like a simple method that suits my timetable and my level of English.

For example, last week I read an old sentence with a missing verb. I wrote a new sentence with the same pattern and checked it against the correction. I think old English answers help me see changes in my writing. An earlier answer shows a specific mistake, so I can compare it with my current sentence during review. But I also notice a difficulty: too many loose pages make the folder difficult to search, so one useful answer sometimes disappears among repeated drafts. I would like to know what I should try next.

Could you please tell me which corrected answers are useful for later review? I also want to know how I can organise them without losing the original notes. I will keep your advice in my notebook and use it in my next practice.

Thank you in advance for your advice.

Yours sincerely,
Xuanye

But I also notice a difficulty: the distant goal has many parts, and thinking about all of them at once makes a small lesson feel difficult. I do not know which change would help me most.

Could you please tell me which basic English skill I need to practise this month? I also want to know where I can find the next course goal. Your advice will help me plan my next study session more carefully.

Xuanye

I think careful reading of the task helps me write a relevant answer. The task names the topic and the number of sentences, so I know the size and purpose of my answer. But I also notice a difficulty: a long prompt sometimes feels difficult at first, and repeated reading without a small plan does not solve every unclear part. I am not sure what I should change first.

Could you please tell me how I can identify every requirement in a writing task? I also want to know what I need to do about an unfamiliar instruction word. I will try your suggestion this week and tell you how it goes.

Xuanye

I think a corrected answer is useful after my own first attempt. The correction shows a clear version of my own idea, so I can connect the explanation with my original sentence. With thanks,
Xuanye

I am writing to ask for advice about taking a short break between study tasks. I would like to improve this part of my study without spending hours on it every day.

But I also notice a difficulty: a break in the middle of one short question breaks the flow, and I need time to remember my place again. I would like to fix this problem before our next class.

Could you please tell me how I can divide this week's homework into small tasks? I also want to know where a useful stopping point falls in the writing exercise. I will practise with your advice before our next class.

But I also notice a difficulty: a new language pattern already needs attention, and unfamiliar clinical words add another difficult part to the first attempt. Xuanye

Hi Amy,

I am writing about using a short daily study list. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a short study plan with clear stopping points. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a study list is useful with room for small changes. A short list gives me a clear first task, so I do not spend my whole break choosing work. But some questions need extra practice, and I want to give these difficult points enough attention at my desk. For example, yesterday I listed three tasks before lunch. One difficult question took extra time, so I moved one small task to another day. This experience gives us a useful starting point for a short discussion.

I will bring a list of my unfinished assignments. Could you please choose the two tasks that need a partner? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notebook and keep a copy of our final work for the next review.

Please tell me about any changes to the time.

See you,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about studying in the school library. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.

I am writing about studying in the school library. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a plan for quiet reading and separate spoken practice. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think I need different study places for different kinds of homework. The quiet tables help me read one page at a time without music from the next room. I can practise English aloud in my room, but the quiet library area is not suitable for this activity. For example, yesterday I read quietly in the library after lunch. Later I returned to my room and practised the same lesson aloud with a classmate. This gives us something real to talk about at the meeting.

I will check the library opening times before our meeting. Could you please bring the names of two books for our nursing chapter? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notes, and we can keep one copy of the plan for both of us.

Let me know if another time is better for you.

Thanks,
Xuanye

tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about studying with a partner. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a checked list of questions for the next lesson. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think partner practice is useful after a short period of individual study. A partner explains an idea in different words, and this sometimes makes the meaning clear to me. But a partner sometimes starts another topic, so I lose my place in the paragraph during our conversation. For example, last week I read my notes alone for ten minutes. Then I met a classmate and we discussed the three points that confused me. We can start from this small example when we meet.

I will prepare five questions from our current chapter. Could you please read the chapter and mark two difficult points? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring a printed copy of our notes and share the final version afterwards.

Please message me if you need to change the plan.

See you then,
Xuanye

tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about managing phone notifications during study. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a notification plan for one short study session. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think I can limit ordinary notifications and keep important class messages. Each message takes my attention away from the page, so I need time to find my place again. But my family also needs a way to reach me about important arrangements during a long day away from home. For example, yesterday I silenced social messages but kept the class group available. I checked the group at my break and returned to my English page. I think this example will make our discussion easier.

I will write down the types of messages from our class. Could you please suggest a suitable time for checking ordinary messages? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will take photos of our final notes and send them to you after the meeting.

If something comes up, just send me a message.

Talk soon,
Xuanye

tasks.zh: 寫信和同學約一次「用紙本筆記本學英文」的小練習。分段寫目的、兩人各自準備什麼、時間地點，以及結束時要完成的成果；至少 120 字。用 will 說安排，用 Could you please 提出禮貌請求。
tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about using a paper notebook for English. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a simple note format with a word and one example. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think paper notes and digital notes have different jobs in my review. I can write a new word beside a simple picture, and this makes the page personal to me. But I can search for an old word quickly and keep related examples together without another heavy book. For example, yesterday I drew a picture in my paper notebook during class. After dinner I copied the difficult word into my phone for later review. It is a good place to begin our planning together.

I will bring one page of paper notes and one digital example. Could you please show me the method that you use for finding old words? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notebook so that we can write the final plan together.

Tell me soon if this time does not work for you.

Cheers,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about doing a short evening review. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.
tasks.zh: 寫信和同學約一次「每天晚上做短時間複習」的小練習。分段寫目的、兩人各自準備什麼、時間地點，以及結束時要完成的成果；至少 120 字。用 will 說安排，用 Could you please 提出禮貌請求。
tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about doing a short evening review. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a flexible review timetable for the next three days. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a flexible review time helps me keep a regular study habit. The lesson is still clear in my memory after class, so I can connect my notes with the teacher's explanation. But the early morning is quiet in my room, and I can study a few notes before the first class. For example, yesterday I reviewed three easy sentences after dinner. I left one difficult question in my notebook for a quiet review the next morning. This experience gives us a useful starting point for a short discussion.

I will list the free periods around our nursing classes. Could you please choose one small exercise for each free period? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notebook and keep a copy of our final work for the next review.

Please tell me about any changes to the time.

See you,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about speaking English aloud. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.
tasks.zh: 寫信和同學約一次「把英文句子念出來」的小練習。分段寫目的、兩人各自準備什麼、時間地點，以及結束時要完成的成果；至少 120 字。用 will 說安排，用 Could you please 提出禮貌請求。
tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about speaking English aloud. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a short recording of our classroom practice. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think I need both silent reading and spoken practice in my English study. I notice missing words more easily in a spoken sentence, so I check the sentence again in my notebook. But I share a small room with another student, so quiet study respects my roommate's rest during the evening. For example, yesterday I first read a new dialogue silently at my desk. Later I practised its short questions aloud in an empty classroom with a friend. This gives us something real to talk about at the meeting.

I will choose a short dialogue from our textbook. Could you please prepare the answers to the questions in the dialogue? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notes, and we can keep one copy of the plan for both of us.

Let me know if another time is better for you.

Thanks,
Xuanye

tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about using colour in class notes. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is one clear note page with a simple colour guide. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a few colours for key points are enough for my class notes. One colour marks the main idea, so I can find the start of a topic quickly before a test. But clear headings also organise a page, and they do not need several pens or extra time during class. For example, yesterday I wrote most notes with one pen during class. After class I added one colour to the two questions that needed more practice. We can start from this small example when we meet.

I will bring a page of notes from our recent lecture. Could you please mark the main idea and two questions on a separate copy? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring a printed copy of our notes and share the final version afterwards.

Please message me if you need to change the plan.

See you then,
Xuanye

tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about keeping a study desk tidy. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a small working area ready for one writing task. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a clear working area matters more than a perfectly arranged room. I find my notebook and pen quickly on a clear desk, so I start the planned work without a search. But a small space for the current book is enough for a short review between two classes on a busy day. For example, yesterday I cleared one part of my desk for English. I finished my task first and sorted the remaining papers during a later break. I think this example will make our discussion easier.

I will list the materials for the current English exercise. Could you please check the list and suggest a place for each item? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will take photos of our final notes and send them to you after the meeting.

If something comes up, just send me a message.

Talk soon,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about planning school meals. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.
tasks.zh: 寫信和同學約一次「事先安排上學日的餐點」的小練習。分段寫目的、兩人各自準備什麼、時間地點，以及結束時要完成的成果；至少 120 字。用 will 說安排，用 Could you please 提出禮貌請求。
tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about planning school meals. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a flexible lunch plan within our usual budget. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a flexible meal plan fits the changes in my school schedule. I know the place and time for lunch, so I do not spend the whole break deciding between several shops. But my classes sometimes finish late, and the shop near the next classroom is more convenient during a short break. For example, yesterday I planned a simple lunch budget before school. After class I checked the menu and chose an available meal within that amount. It is a good place to begin our planning together.

I will check the dining room menu and our afternoon timetable. Could you please suggest a second place for lunch near the next classroom? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notebook so that we can write the final plan together.

Tell me soon if this time does not work for you.

Cheers,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about keeping a weekly spending record. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.

tasks.sample:
Hi Amy,

I am writing about keeping a weekly spending record. I want to meet in the school discussion room at four on Wednesday. Our aim is a short budget sheet for one ordinary school week. Could you please tell me whether that time works for you?

I think a weekly record of important purchases works well for me. The record shows the cost of transport and food separately, so I know the money for these regular needs. Also, a clear limit for each week is easy to remember and gives me a quick guide at the shop. For example, last week I wrote down a new textbook and my transport costs. On Sunday I checked the remaining money and planned the next week. This experience gives us a useful starting point for a short discussion.

I will list the transport and textbook costs for this week. Could you please prepare a blank table for food and other small purchases? We will compare our ideas with the course notes and write down any questions for our teacher. I will bring my notebook and keep a copy of our final work for the next review.

Please tell me about any changes to the time.

See you,
Xuanye

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a classmate planning a short meeting about using a group chat for class. Explain the purpose, suggest work for each person, give a clear time and place, and say what you want to finish.
